title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: $\textit{(i)}$ fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), $\textit{(ii)}$ consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), and $\textit{(iii)}$ efficiency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories quickly). We propose WEAVER (World Estimation Across Views for Embodied Reasoning): a WM architecture that simultaneously achieves all three desiderata, providing state-of-the-art results on robotic manipulation tasks. WEAVER is a multi-view WM trained to predict future latents and reward values via a flow-matching loss. We distill the key design decisions across model architecture, memory, and prediction objectives required to unlock the kinds of long-horizon dynamic manipulation tasks that have confounded prior world modeling approaches. We apply WEAVER in robotic hardware, demonstrating its effectiveness at policy evaluation ($ρ$=0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of $38\%$ on top of the $π_{0.5}$ robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of $14\%$ with a $5-10\times$ speedup over prior WMs). WEAVER also demonstrates better performance than prior WMs when evaluated on out-of-distribution scenarios. Code, models, and videos at: https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/ .

AI.title_translation: WEAVER：更好、更快、更长——一种用于机器人操纵的有效世界模型
AI.tldr: WEAVER是一种新型机器人世界模型，通过多视角建模和流匹配损失，在保持高保真度和长程一致性的同时，显著提升了机器人操纵任务中的评估、规划效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型在机器人操纵任务中难以同时满足保真度、长程一致性和计算效率这三个关键要求，限制了其在策略评估、改进及规划中的应用。
AI.method: 提出WEAVER架构，采用多视角世界模型，利用流匹配损失训练模型以预测未来的潜在状态和奖励值，并结合了优化的模型架构、记忆机制和预测目标。
AI.result: WEAVER在机器人操纵任务中达到了SOTA水平，在策略评估中与真实成功率的相关性达0.870，策略改进方面提升了38%的成功率，测试时规划速度提升了5-10倍，并在分布外场景中表现优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: WEAVER证明了通过优化模型架构、记忆机制和预测目标，可以构建出既高效又具备高保真度和长程一致性的世界模型，显著增强了机器人在操纵任务中的泛化、规划与评估能力。
AI.translation: 世界模型（WMs，即学习到的模拟器）对机器人的潜在影响是深远的——包括策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划——所有这些都只需有限的现实世界交互。为了释放这些下游能力，WM需要共同满足三个愿望：(i) 保真度（即产生与现实相关的模拟轨迹），(ii) 一致性（即产生在长视野内连贯的模拟轨迹），以及 (iii) 效率（即快速产生模拟轨迹）。我们提出了WEAVER（具身推理的多视角世界估计）：一种同时实现所有这三个愿望的WM架构，在机器人操纵任务上提供了最先进的结果。WEAVER是一个多视角WM，经过训练可通过流匹配损失预测未来的潜在状态和奖励值。我们提炼了跨模型架构、记忆和预测目标的关键设计决策，这些决策对于解锁之前世界建模方法难以应对的长视野动态操纵任务是必要的。我们将WEAVER应用于机器人硬件，证明了其在策略评估（与现实世界成功率的相关性为ρ=0.870）、策略改进（在π0.5机器人基础模型基础上现实世界成功率提高了38%）和测试时规划（成功率提高了14%，速度比之前的WM快5-10倍）方面的有效性。当在分布外场景进行评估时，WEAVER也表现出比之前的WM更好的性能。代码、模型和视频位于：https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/ 。
AI.summary: WEAVER是一种多视角世界模型架构，旨在解决机器人操纵中对长程预测的高保真、一致性和效率需求。通过利用流匹配损失及创新的架构设计，WEAVER在机器人硬件测试中展现了卓越的策略评估、改进及规划能力。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 机器人操纵, 流匹配, 长程预测, 多视角建模
AI.comments: WEAVER通过在多视角建模、流匹配损失和长程预测设计上的创新，解决了机器人世界模型在保真度、一致性和效率之间的权衡难题，为机器人操纵任务的策略评估与优化提供了强有力的方法论支撑。其在实际硬件上的显著性能提升证明了该架构的实用价值。

title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, yet most evaluations assume static environments. In contrast, real-world deployment is inherently dynamic, requiring agents to continually align their knowledge, skills, and behavior with changing environments and updated task conditions. To address this gap, we introduce EvoArena, a benchmark suite that models environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains. We further propose EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records memory evolution as structured update histories, enabling agents to reason about environmental evolution through changes in their memory. Experiments show that current agents struggle on EvoArena, achieving an average accuracy of 39.6% across evolving terminal, software, and social-preference domains. EvoMem consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of 1.5% on EvoArena and also improving standard benchmarks such as GAIA and LoCoMo by 6.1% and 4.8%. Beyond individual tasks, EvoMem further improves chain-level accuracy by 3.7% on EvoArena, where success requires completing a consecutive sequence of related evolutionary subtasks. Mechanistic analysis shows that EvoMem improves evidence capture in the memory, indicating better preservation of complete evolving environment states. Our results highlight the importance of modeling evolution in both evaluation and memory for reliable agent deployment.

title: CineOrchestra: Unified Entity-Centric Conditioning for Cinematic Video Generation
summary: Cinematic video depicts multiple subjects acting or interacting at specific moments, captured with deliberate camera movement, and stitched together by shot transitions. Together, these elements demand a level of fine-grained control beyond current text-to-video models. Existing work addresses each axis in isolation: multi-subject personalization, temporal control, multi-shot synthesis, or camera control; no prior framework jointly integrates all four. We present CineOrchestra, a unified video diffusion model that controls subjects, events, cameras, and shot transitions simultaneously. Our key insight is that these heterogeneous cinematic elements share a fundamental structure: each is an entity acting over a specific temporal interval, which can therefore all be expressed through one shared structure of entity-centric conditioning primitives, augmented with reference images for visual entities. This formulation reduces the architectural challenge to a single positional encoding problem, which we solve with two parameter-free coordinated rotary embeddings: (a) an interval-sampled temporal RoPE that yields consistent attention behavior across events of dramatically varying duration, and (b) a 2D entity-temporal cross-attention RoPE that disambiguates per-entity conditions and routes each to its corresponding spatiotemporal region. On two new benchmarks, CineOrchestra outperforms six per-axis specialists on dense caption following and shot-transition timing, with consistent gains in a pairwise user study and component ablations. Project page: https://snap-research.github.io/CineOrchestra

AI.title_translation: CineOrchestra：用于电影视频生成的统一实体中心化条件框架
AI.tldr: CineOrchestra 是一种新型视频扩散模型，通过统一的条件机制实现了对角色、事件、镜头和摄像机运动的同时精准控制，解决了以往模型无法协同处理这些复杂电影要素的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本生成视频模型在处理电影级创作时，往往只能孤立地处理多主体个性化、时间控制、多镜头合成或摄像机控制中的某一方面，缺乏一个能同时整合这四个维度的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的视频扩散模型架构，将不同电影元素抽象为“在特定时间间隔内作用的实体”；引入了两种无参数的协调旋转嵌入（Coordinated RoPE）：(a) 间隔采样的时序 RoPE 用于处理不同持续时间的事件，(b) 2D 实体-时序交叉注意力 RoPE 用于解耦实体条件并将其路由至对应的时空区域。
AI.result: 在两个新基准测试中，CineOrchestra 在密集字幕跟随和镜头切换时序方面均优于六种专用模型，并在用户研究和消融实验中表现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: CineOrchestra 通过统一的实体中心化调节机制，成功实现了对电影视频生成中多个维度的细粒度控制，为高质量、可控的视频创作提供了新的技术路径。
AI.translation: 电影视频描绘了多个主体在特定时刻的动作或互动，通过精心设计的摄像机运动捕捉，并由镜头切换拼接而成。这些元素共同要求具备超越当前文本生成视频模型的细粒度控制能力。现有的工作通常孤立地解决这些问题：多主体个性化、时间控制、多镜头合成或摄像机控制；目前尚无框架能将这四者有机地结合起来。我们提出了 CineOrchestra，这是一个统一的视频扩散模型，可以同时控制主体、事件、摄像机和镜头切换。我们的核心见解是，这些异构的电影元素共享一种基本结构：每一个都是在特定时间间隔内作用的实体，因此都可以通过共享的实体中心化条件基元来表达，并辅以视觉实体的参考图像。这种表述将架构挑战简化为一个单一的位置编码问题，我们通过两种无参数的协调旋转嵌入解决了这个问题：(a) 一种间隔采样的时序 RoPE，在不同持续时间的事件中产生一致的注意力行为；(b) 一种 2D 实体-时序交叉注意力 RoPE，用于消除每实体条件的歧义，并将每个条件路由到其对应的时空区域。在两个新基准测试中，CineOrchestra 在密集字幕跟随和镜头切换时序方面优于六种专用模型，并在成对用户研究和组件消融实验中表现出持续的提升。项目页面：https://snap-research.github.io/CineOrchestra
AI.summary: CineOrchestra 是一种统一的视频扩散模型，旨在实现对电影视频中主体、事件、摄像机运动和镜头切换的同步控制。它通过将复杂的电影元素统一为“以实体为中心”的条件基元，并利用创新的旋转嵌入技术解决时空对齐问题，从而克服了现有模型在细粒度控制上的局限性。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 扩散模型, 实体中心调节, 电影级控制, 空间时间注意力
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种将不同电影拍摄元素（角色、事件、摄像机运动、镜头切换）统一为“以实体为中心”的条件框架，简化了复杂的视频生成控制问题，并在多项指标上超越了专用模型，具有很高的实用价值。

title: DiPOD: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
summary: RL post-training has become increasingly pivotal for improving diffusion policies, but existing diffusion policy-gradient methods are often unstable and cannot achieve reliable policy improvement. We identify the cause as the double-drift phenomenon: optimizing a variational surrogate can let the ELBO separate from the true log-likelihood, which then makes the resulting proxy policy gradient misaligned with the true policy gradient of expected return. We propose \textbf{DiPOD}, a diffusion policy optimization framework that maintains tight-bound behavior throughout training by interleaving self-distillation with policy-improving gradient updates. This leads to a simple and practical algorithm: augmenting each diffusion policy-gradient update with an on-policy ELBO regularizer. Across diffusion language model post-training and continuous-control diffusion policies, DiPOD substantially stabilizes training and reaches higher rewards than previous methods.

title: FastContext: Training Efficient Repository Explorer for Coding Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) coding agents have achieved strong results on software engineering tasks, yet repository exploration remains a major bottleneck: locating relevant code consumes substantial token budget and pollutes the agent's context with irrelevant snippets. In most agents, the same model explores the repository and solves the task, leaving exploratory reads and searches in the solver's history. We present FastContext, a dedicated exploration subagent that separates repository exploration from solving. Invoked on demand, FastContext issues parallel tool calls and returns concise file paths and line ranges as focused context. FastContext is powered by specialized exploration models spanning 4B--30B parameters. We bootstrap them from strong reference-model trajectories and refine them with task-grounded rewards for broad first-turn search, multi-turn evidence gathering, and precise citation generation. Across SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-bench Pro, and SWE-QA, integrating FastContext into Mini-SWE-Agent improves end-to-end resolution rates up to 5.5% while reducing coding-agent token consumption up to 60%, with marginal overhead. These results show that repository exploration can be separated from solving and handled effectively by specialized models. Code and data: https://github.com/microsoft/fastcontext

AI.title_translation: FastContext：为编程智能体训练高效的代码库探索器
AI.tldr: FastContext通过独立的轻量级探索代理，在减少60% Token消耗的同时提升了编程智能体的任务解决率。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM编程智能体在代码库探索阶段不仅消耗大量Token，还会因无关代码污染上下文，导致求解效率低下。
AI.method: 提出FastContext专用探索子代理，与求解器分离；使用4B-30B参数的专用模型；采用引导式训练（Bootstrap）并结合任务导向的奖励机制（task-grounded rewards）进行微调。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench等基准测试中，将FastContext集成到Mini-SWE-Agent后，任务解决率提升高达5.5%，Token消耗降低高达60%，且运行开销极低。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，将代码库探索从求解过程中分离出来，并使用经过专门训练的轻量级模型进行处理，能显著提高编程智能体的效率和性能。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）编程智能体在软件工程任务中取得了显著成果，但代码库探索仍然是一个主要的瓶颈：定位相关代码会消耗大量的Token预算，并用无关的代码片段污染智能体的上下文。在大多数智能体中，同一个模型既负责探索代码库又负责解决任务，这使得探索性的阅读和搜索记录留在了求解器的历史记录中。我们提出了FastContext，一个专门的探索子代理，它将代码库探索与求解任务分离开来。FastContext按需调用，通过并行工具调用返回简洁的文件路径和行范围作为重点上下文。FastContext由参数范围在4B到30B之间的专用探索模型驱动。我们利用强大的参考模型轨迹对它们进行引导，并使用基于任务的奖励进行微调，以实现广泛的首次搜索、多轮证据收集和精确的引用生成。在SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro和SWE-QA的测试中，将FastContext集成到Mini-SWE-Agent中，端到端的任务解决率提高了5.5%，同时将编程智能体的Token消耗降低了60%，且开销微乎其微。这些结果表明，代码库探索可以与求解任务分离，并由专用模型有效地处理。代码和数据见：https://github.com/microsoft/fastcontext
AI.summary: FastContext是一个专用于代码库探索的轻量级子代理，通过将探索任务与求解任务解耦，利用专用模型进行高效的路径和代码片段检索，在显著降低Token消耗的同时提升了编程智能体的整体性能。
AI.keywords: 编程智能体, 代码库探索, 大语言模型, Token优化, 任务解耦
AI.comments: FastContext的创新之处在于将“代码库探索”与“任务求解”这两个任务解耦，通过轻量级专用子代理（Subagent）来减少LLM在探索阶段的Token消耗，同时提升了任务完成的准确率。这为构建更高效的编程智能体提供了一种模块化的思路。

title: MeEvo: Metacognitive Evolution Combined with Natural Evolution for Automatic Heuristic Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) by enabling heuristic generation through reasoning and code synthesis. Existing LLM-based AHD architectures mainly follow two paradigms: Natural Evolution, which uses crossover and mutation to explore heuristic programs, and Metacognitive Evolution, which refines reasoning through reflection. However, Natural Evolution discards reasoning traces, weakening knowledge inheritance and exploitation, while Metacognitive Evolution lacks population-level recombination, limiting exploration and increasing the risk of premature convergence. These limitations reduce search efficiency, stability, and solution quality on complex problems. To address this gap, we propose MeEvo, a dual-layer AHD framework that cyclically couples Natural Evolution and Metacognitive Evolution. Natural Evolution explores heuristic code while recording reasoning traces, fitness values, and errors into a shared history; Metacognitive Evolution then reflects on this history to generate improved heuristics that re-enter the parent pool for the next cycle. This design enables population-driven exploration and reflection-driven refinement to reinforce each other. Experiments on five optimization problems with two LLM backbones show that MeEvo achieves stronger and more stable performance than existing LLM-based AHD architectures, especially on complex constrained tasks.

AI.title_translation: MeEvo：结合元认知进化与自然进化的自动化启发式设计
AI.tldr: MeEvo通过结合种群进化探索与元认知反思机制，显著提升了LLM在自动化启发式设计中的性能与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM驱动的自动启发式设计（AHD）中，自然进化方法丢失了推理轨迹导致知识难以继承，而元认知进化缺乏种群重组导致探索不足且易过早收敛，限制了复杂问题下的搜索效率与解的质量。
AI.method: 提出MeEvo框架， cyclically（循环）耦合了自然进化与元认知进化：自然进化负责种群探索并记录推理轨迹、适应度及错误；元认知进化利用该历史记录进行反思，生成改进的启发式算法并反馈至种群池。
AI.result: 在五个优化问题及两个LLM基座上的实验表明，MeEvo在搜索效率、稳定性和解的质量上均优于现有的LLM-based AHD架构，尤其在复杂约束任务中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MeEvo通过双层循环机制实现了种群探索与元认知反思的互补，显著提升了自动化启发式设计的搜索效率、稳定性和解的质量。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过推理和代码合成实现启发式生成，推动了自动化启发式设计（AHD）的发展。现有的基于LLM的AHD架构主要遵循两种范式：利用交叉和变异探索启发式程序的“自然进化”，以及通过反思优化推理的“元认知进化”。然而，自然进化丢弃了推理轨迹，削弱了知识的继承和利用；而元认知进化缺乏种群层面的重组，限制了探索并增加了过早收敛的风险。这些局限性降低了在复杂问题上的搜索效率、稳定性和解的质量。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了MeEvo，这是一个循环耦合自然进化和元认知进化的双层AHD框架。自然进化探索启发式代码，同时将推理轨迹、适应度值和错误记录到共享历史中；元认知进化随后对这些历史进行反思，生成改进的启发式算法，并重新进入父代池进行下一轮循环。这种设计使得种群驱动的探索和反思驱动的改进能够相互促进。在五个优化问题和两个LLM基座上的实验表明，MeEvo比现有的基于LLM的AHD架构实现了更强、更稳定的性能，特别是在复杂的约束任务中。
AI.summary: MeEvo是一种双层自动化启发式设计框架，通过将自然进化（种群探索）与元认知进化（知识反思）循环耦合，利用历史推理轨迹强化启发式算法的生成与迭代，从而克服了单一范式的局限性。
AI.keywords: 自动化启发式设计, 大语言模型, 元认知进化, 自然进化, 协同优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的双层架构有效地结合了进化算法的种群探索能力与大模型的元认知反射能力，解决了现有AHD方法中知识利用不足和易陷入局部最优的问题，为自动化启发式算法设计提供了一种高效、鲁棒的新范式。

title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
summary: Current automated pipelines for audio-visual Question Answering (QA) generally adopt a ``video-caption-QA'' paradigm. However, these methods typically segment videos into short clips and generate separate descriptions for audio and visual modalities. This decoupled processing severs inherent associations between sounds and their visual sources, while independent clip processing often causes inconsistent descriptions of the same entity across segments. Furthermore, coupling long-text comprehension and QA synthesis into a single step often restricts models to localized events, yielding questions lacking long-term temporal connections and deep cross-modal reasoning. To address these issues, we propose an automated data engine featuring two mechanisms: (1) \textbf{Entity-Anchored Video Scripting} transforms videos into structured scripts, comprising summaries, main entity lists, and segment-wise audio-visual descriptions. The entity list serves as a global prior to ensure cross-segment referential consistency and reconstruct audio-visual associations. (2) \textbf{Clue-Guided QA Generation} prompts models to first mine cross-segment, multimodal clues from the script, and subsequently generate QA pairs based on these high-value clues. Leveraging this pipeline, we construct the instruction-tuning dataset \textbf{OmniVideo-100K} and a human-verified test set, \textbf{OmniVideo-Test}. Fine-tuning VITA-1.5, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and Qwen3-Omni-30B on OmniVideo-100K yields performance gains of up to 20.59% on OmniVideo-Test, demonstrating strong generalization (up to 12.64% improvements) across established benchmarks like Daily-Omni and JointAVBench.

AI.title_translation: OmniVideo-100K：一个通过结构化脚本和证据链进行视听推理的数据集
AI.tldr: 为了解决音视频QA中模态解耦和长时序推理不足的问题，本文构建了OmniVideo-100K数据集，通过引入结构化脚本和证据链，显著提升了模型在跨片段多模态任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的“视频-字幕-QA”范式存在视听模态解耦、跨片段描述不一致以及难以进行长时序深度推理等问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含两个机制的自动化数据引擎：一是“实体锚定视频脚本化”，通过实体列表确保跨片段的一致性并重构视听关联；二是“线索引导QA生成”，通过挖掘跨片段的多模态线索来生成高质量QA对。
AI.result: 构建了OmniVideo-100K数据集。在VITA-1.5、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Qwen3-Omni-30B模型上的微调显示，OmniVideo-Test性能提升最高达20.59%，在Daily-Omni等基准测试上泛化能力提升最高达12.64%。
AI.conclusion: OmniVideo-100K数据集及构建方法有效提升了多模态模型在长时序、跨模态推理任务中的表现，验证了结构化脚本与线索驱动生成在多模态指令微调中的有效性。
AI.translation: 当前的自动化视听问答（QA）流水线通常采用“视频-字幕-QA”范式。然而，这些方法通常将视频分割成短片段，并为音频和视觉模态分别生成描述。这种解耦处理切断了声音与其视觉来源之间的内在联系，而独立的片段处理往往导致同一实体在不同片段间描述不一致。此外，将长文本理解与QA合成耦合在单一步骤中，往往限制模型仅关注局部事件，导致问题缺乏长期的时序联系和深度的跨模态推理。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个自动化数据引擎，包含两个机制：(1) 实体锚定视频脚本化，将视频转换为结构化脚本，包括摘要、主要实体列表以及片段级的视听描述。实体列表作为全局先验，确保跨片段的指代一致性并重构视听关联。(2) 线索引导QA生成，提示模型首先从脚本中挖掘跨片段的多模态线索，随后基于这些高价值线索生成QA对。利用该流水线，我们构建了指令微调数据集OmniVideo-100K以及一个人工验证的测试集OmniVideo-Test。在OmniVideo-100K上对VITA-1.5、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Qwen3-Omni-30B进行微调，在OmniVideo-Test上性能提升高达20.59%，并在Daily-Omni和JointAVBench等既有基准测试中展现出强大的泛化能力（提升高达12.64%）。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有音视频问答模型在长时序推理和模态关联上的不足，提出了OmniVideo-100K数据集。通过实体锚定脚本化和线索引导的QA生成机制，实现了跨片段的语义一致性和深度跨模态推理，显著增强了模型在复杂音视频任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 音视频问答, 多模态推理, 指令微调, 结构化脚本, 跨时序一致性
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的数据引擎解决了音视频QA中跨模态关联缺失和长时序推理能力不足的问题。其引入的“实体锚定”和“线索引导”机制为构建高质量的多模态数据集提供了有效范式，对提升大模型的长时序音视频理解能力具有重要意义。

title: When the Same Musical Knowledge Forgets Differently: A Clean Probe of Pathway-Dependent Forgetting
summary: A model can learn that the piano piece Für Elise is calm and reflective by listening to the audio or by reading a text description, but does it matter which route that knowledge took when it is later at risk of being forgotten? Forgetting research in multimodal models measures what knowledge is lost under adaptation, yet has not asked whether acquisition route affects how easily that knowledge is forgotten. We call this untested premise the Pathway-Invariant Assumption. Music understanding enables a clean test because a music clip and a canonical text description can be aligned to the same perceptual content, allowing the same knowledge unit to enter a model through listening or reading while the target remains fixed. Across multiple architecturally distinct audio-language models, we observe a consistent asymmetry: text-pathway knowledge is forgotten more than matched audio-pathway knowledge under identical adaptation pressure. To attribute this effect to route rather than confounds, we introduce the Paired Pathway Controlled Protocol (PPCP), a three-phase design that establishes matched pathway baselines, activates both pathways under symmetric supervision on the same knowledge pool, and applies identical forgetting pressure to both pathways. The gap is stable across models and gain-controlled analyses, persists when contradictory overwrite is replaced by correct-label cross-domain learning, remains under single-modality pressure, and is not removed by lightweight replay. Two independent routing-depth controls confirm that the effect is not explained by architectural depth, pointing to input representation as the dominant factor. Under PPCP, our results demonstrate that forgetting is highly route-dependent, establishing acquisition route as a new analytical dimension for forgetting research and multimodal system design.

AI.title_translation: 当相同的音乐知识以不同方式被遗忘时：路径依赖性遗忘的清晰探测
AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态模型中，通过文本学习的知识比通过音频学习的知识更容易被遗忘，揭示了知识获取路径在遗忘过程中的重要作用。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态遗忘研究忽略了“获取路径不变假设”，即未考虑知识通过不同模态进入模型是否影响其后续的遗忘易感性。
AI.method: 引入配对路径控制协议（PPCP），通过三阶段设计（基线建立、对称监督激活、施加相同遗忘压力）在保持知识内容一致的前提下，对比音频路径和文本路径的知识遗忘率。
AI.result: 研究发现存在显著的不对称性：在相同的适应压力下，文本路径获取的知识比音频路径获取的知识更容易被遗忘，且该结论在多种架构模型中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘现象具有高度的路径依赖性，获取知识的路径（音频或文本）显著影响模型在后续适应过程中的遗忘程度。获取路径应成为多模态系统设计和遗忘研究的一个关键分析维度。
AI.translation: 模型可以通过听音频或读文本描述来学习钢琴曲《致爱丽丝》是平静且引人深思的，但当这些知识面临被遗忘的风险时，获取路径是否重要？多模态模型中的遗忘研究通常衡量适应过程中丢失了什么知识，但尚未探讨获取路径是否影响知识被遗忘的难易程度。我们将这一未经检验的前提称为“路径不变假设”。音乐理解提供了一个清晰的测试场景，因为音乐片段和规范的文本描述可以对齐到相同的感知内容，允许相同的知识单元通过听或读进入模型，同时目标保持不变。在多个架构不同的音频-语言模型中，我们观察到一种一致的不对称性：在相同的适应压力下，文本路径知识比匹配的音频路径知识更容易被遗忘。为了将这种效应归因于路径而非混杂因素，我们引入了配对路径控制协议（PPCP），这是一种三阶段设计，建立了匹配的路径基线，在相同的知识库上对两条路径进行对称监督，并对两条路径施加相同的遗忘压力。这种差距在不同模型和增益控制分析中保持稳定，在用正确标签的跨域学习替换矛盾覆盖时依然存在，在单模态压力下依然存在，且不会被轻量级重放消除。两个独立的路由深度控制证实，这种效应不能用架构深度来解释，表明输入表征是主导因素。在PPCP下，我们的结果表明遗忘具有高度的路径依赖性，确立了获取路径作为遗忘研究和多模态系统设计的一个新分析维度。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了多模态模型中知识获取路径对遗忘的影响。通过对比音频和文本路径在相同知识内容下的表现，研究发现文本路径获取的知识比音频路径更容易遗忘，并提出了PPCP协议来验证这一现象的稳健性。
AI.keywords: 多模态模型, 遗忘机制, 路径依赖, 音乐理解, PPCP协议
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了“路径依赖遗忘”的概念，并设计了PPCP协议来严格控制变量，揭示了多模态模型中知识获取路径对遗忘机制的关键影响。这对理解模型鲁棒性和多模态学习具有重要意义。

title: Sensory Restoration via Brain-Computer Interfaces: A Unified 2 x 2 Framework and Convergence Roadmap
summary: Millions of individuals worldwide suffer from sensory and communication deficits caused by neurodegenerative diseases, stroke, or trauma. Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising avenue for sensory and motor restoration. However, the scientific literature remains highly fragmented between invasive neuroprosthetics and non-invasive electrophysiological decoders, with a lack of consistent terminology and comparison metrics. This chapter proposes a unified 2 x 2 framework categorizing BCIs along two axes: degree of invasiveness (invasive vs. non-invasive) and signal direction (afferent sensory-IN vs. efferent sensory-OUT). We define and distinguish the paradigms of restoration, substitution, and augmentation. Furthermore, we outline a structural roadmap for the convergence of these modalities over near-, medium-, and long-term horizons, focusing on physical limits and the integrative role of machine learning foundation models.

title: Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus
summary: Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

AI.title_translation: 超越单语深度研究：利用跨语言BrowseComp-Plus评估智能体与检索器
AI.tldr: 研究表明，跨语言环境严重削弱了深度研究智能体的检索能力和推理准确性，即使提供正确证据，智能体也难以有效整合语言不匹配的信息。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览基准测试主要假设查询和证据处于同一语言，忽略了现实中智能体在跨语言环境下检索和推理证据的能力，因此需要评估跨语言搜索系统的性能。
AI.method: 引入了XBCP（Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus）基准测试，在保持英语问答空间不变的前提下，通过跨语言和多语言设置，对四种深度研究智能体及多种稀疏/密集检索器进行了评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，当证据转换为其他语言时，系统性能显著下降；密集检索器的证据召回率降低，智能体的回答准确率、校准能力及引用可靠性均受到负面影响，即便在提供完整金标准证据时，准确率依然较低。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言深度研究不仅面临检索失效问题，智能体在处理语言不匹配的证据时也存在显著的推理和整合困难。
AI.translation: 深度研究智能体在搜索证据、推理来源及生成有据可查的答案方面的能力正受到越来越多的评估。然而，现有的浏览基准测试主要假设用户的查询和支持性证据使用相同的语言，这使得智能搜索系统在相关证据以其他语言出现时能否正常运作成为一个悬而未决的问题。我们引入了XBCP（Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus），这是一个受控基准测试，它保留了BrowseComp-Plus的英语问答空间，但改变了支持性文档的语言。XBCP实例化了两种互补的设置：在跨语言设置中，每个查询都配有单一指定语言的证据；在多语言设置中，完整的证据语料库被平均且随机地分布在涵盖高资源和低资源机制的12种语言中。我们使用稀疏和密集多语言检索器评估了四种深度研究智能体，测量了答案准确性、证据召回率、搜索行为、校准、引用保真度和预言机检索。结果显示，当证据被翻译时，性能会大幅下降。即使是强大的密集检索器也会丢失证据召回，智能体的校准能力变差，引用证据的可靠性降低。值得注意的是，即使直接提供所有金标准证据，准确率仍然较低。这些发现表明，跨语言深度研究不仅暴露了检索失败问题，还揭示了智能体在整合语言不匹配证据时存在独立的困难。
AI.summary: 本文提出了XBCP基准测试，旨在评估深度研究智能体在跨语言场景下的表现。研究发现，跨语言环境会导致检索器召回能力下降，且智能体在整合非英语证据时存在推理难度，导致整体回答质量与可靠性降低。
AI.keywords: 深度研究, 跨语言, 智能体评估, 检索系统, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究首次系统性地揭示了现有深度研究智能体在跨语言环境下的能力缺陷，不仅指出了检索端的挑战，还强调了智能体在整合多语言证据时的推理困难。对于推动全球化AI应用的发展具有重要的参考价值。

title: Toward Vibe Medicine: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical Decision Support
summary: In recent years, the advances of large language models and autonomous agents have revolutionized the healthcare field, facilitating diagnosis and improving treatment results. However, most existing AI systems rely on pre-trained knowledge and predefined pipelines, which struggle to learn dynamically from the interactive chat session history that contains patient outcomes and past failures. To address this limitation, we propose VIBEMed, a multi-agent framework with a built-in self-evolution mechanism and architecture-level safety sandbox for robust clinical decision support. The system integrates three specialized agents, including a Clinical Diagnostic Agent (CDA) for hypothesis generation, a Therapeutic Execution Agent (TEA) for treatment planning, and a Clinical Evolution Manager Agent (CEMA) that distills longitudinal clinical feedback into reusable knowledge, transforming multimodal patient information into personalized medical decisions. Through self-evolution mechanism, the framework enables iterative updates across memory, model behavior, and decision strategies, allowing the system to improve over time. Experimental results show that VIBEMed demonstrates superior performance through its evolving mechanism in complex clinical cases, particularly in tasks that require integrated decision-making and longitudinal planning. The framework also supports reliable end-to-end decisions in challenging scenarios such as oncology treatment planning, highlighting its feasibility in real-world clinical contexts. Overall, VIBEMed provides a practical path beyond static AI systems toward adaptive, experience-driven clinical decision support, demonstrating the value of combining multi-agent collaboration with continuous evolution for advancing precision medicine.

AI.title_translation: 迈向振动医学：一种用于临床决策支持的自我演化多智能体框架
AI.tldr: VIBEMed是一个创新的多智能体医疗AI框架，能够通过自我演化机制从临床经验中持续学习，从而提升复杂医疗决策的准确性和适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI医疗系统多依赖预训练知识和预定义流程，缺乏从患者预后和历史失败案例中进行动态学习的能力，难以适应复杂的临床需求。
AI.method: 提出VIBEMed框架，由三个核心智能体组成：临床诊断智能体（CDA）用于假设生成、治疗执行智能体（TEA）用于治疗规划、临床演化管理智能体（CEMA）用于将纵向临床反馈转化为可重用知识；并构建了架构级安全沙箱以确保系统稳健性。
AI.result: 实验证明，VIBEMed框架在处理复杂临床病例（如肿瘤治疗规划）时表现优异，其自我演化机制显著提升了系统在长期规划和综合决策任务中的性能。
AI.conclusion: VIBEMed框架通过整合多智能体协作与自我演化机制，成功克服了传统静态AI在临床决策中的局限性，为实现更精准、自适应的个性化医疗提供了可行路径。
AI.translation: 近年来，大语言模型和自主智能体的进步彻底改变了医疗领域，促进了诊断并改善了治疗结果。然而，大多数现有的AI系统依赖于预训练知识和预定义的流程，难以从包含患者预后和过去失败案例的交互聊天记录中进行动态学习。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了VIBEMed，这是一个具有内置自我演化机制和架构级安全沙箱的多智能体框架，用于稳健的临床决策支持。该系统集成了三个专业智能体，包括用于假设生成的临床诊断智能体（CDA）、用于治疗规划的治疗执行智能体（TEA），以及将纵向临床反馈提炼为可重用知识的临床演化管理智能体（CEMA），从而将多模态患者信息转化为个性化的医疗决策。通过自我演化机制，该框架实现了记忆、模型行为和决策策略的迭代更新，使系统能够随时间推移而不断改进。实验结果表明，VIBEMed通过其演化机制在复杂临床病例中表现出优越的性能，特别是在需要综合决策和纵向规划的任务中。该框架还支持在肿瘤治疗规划等挑战性场景中进行可靠的端到端决策，突显了其在现实临床环境中的可行性。总的来说，VIBEMed提供了一条超越静态AI系统的实用路径，迈向自适应、经验驱动的临床决策支持，证明了将多智能体协作与持续演化相结合对于推进精准医疗的价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VIBEMed，一种用于临床决策支持的多智能体框架。该系统通过内置的自我演化机制和安全沙箱，整合了诊断、治疗和演化管理智能体，能够从临床反馈中持续更新记忆和决策策略，从而实现经验驱动的精准医疗。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 自我演化, 临床决策支持, 大语言模型, 精准医疗
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个具有自我演化能力的临床决策支持框架，其创新之处在于能够从历史交互中学习并进行自我迭代，而非仅仅依赖静态预训练知识。这种动态学习机制对于临床医疗这种需要持续积累经验的领域具有重要意义。局限性在于未详细说明在处理实时临床数据时的隐私保护细节及极端医疗错误下的安全鲁棒性边界。

title: Multi-tier Differential Private Query Release
summary: Answering statistical queries over sensitive data under differential privacy (DP) is a common task in many settings, including databases, mobile computing, and data markets. In these scenarios, multiple analysts may issue the same query, while receiving answers generated under different privacy budgets due to differences in trust levels or willingness to pay. Existing approaches for such multi-tier DP queries either incur excessive cumulative privacy loss or suffer from suboptimal utility. In this paper, we propose a framework for multi-tier DP query release that simultaneously bound the cumulative privacy loss by the maximum privacy budget among all queries and achieve optimal utility comparable to that of single-tier mechanisms. Our framework applies to different classes of DP mechanisms. For noise-adding mechanisms (e.g., count queries with the two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we develop a general solution based on the characteristic functions of noise distributions. For other mechanisms (e.g., count queries under the local DP model with the Subset mechanism), we design mechanism-specific primitives for budget transformation and introduce a template-based strategy that attains optimal utility across different privacy regimes. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

title: RaLMPH: Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization in Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is a standard paradigm for Whole-Slide Image (WSI) analysis and has achieved strong results in computational pathology. However, most MIL pipelines assume a single "gold" label per slide, which conflicts with clinical practice where substantial inter-pathologist variability is common. Existing multi-annotator learning and label-refinement methods typically estimate global annotator reliability or rely on single-instance assumptions, making them poorly suited to MIL and to localized diagnostic contexts where experts disagree. We propose RaLMPH (Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization), a MIL-based label reconciliation framework for WSIs annotated by multiple pathologists. RaLMPH introduces a reliability field that jointly models (i) local neighborhood structure in WSI feature space and (ii) expert uncertainty (entropy), enabling per-sample identification of trustworthy reference neighborhoods. Leveraging this field, RaLMPH performs sample-wise local annotator ranking to select reliable opinions per slide and applies an adaptive gating mechanism to fuse labels conditioned on local reliability. Experiments on a clinical WSI dataset with labels from six pathologists, as well as controlled simulated benchmarks, show that RaLMPH consistently outperforms existing approaches. Further analyses clarify how our reliability-aware mechanism improves label reconciliation and downstream MIL performance.

title: Open-World Video Segmentation
summary: While video segmentation has advanced rapidly on short clips and closed-set benchmarks, open-world video segmentation remains largely unexplored. The challenge is twofold: (1) existing methods are not designed to support object discovery and identity maintenance in long videos of dynamic ego-motion, and (2) existing evaluation protocols rely on a rigid 1:1 matching that unfairly penalizes semantically valid predictions with mismatched granularity. To address both gaps, we introduce Savvy, a practical and strong system for zero-shot open-world long-horizon video segmentation. Savvy combines hierarchical mask discovery, deferred admission, and track consolidation to support persistent object discovery, safe track promotion, and stable long-range identity maintenance. We further propose OGA, a granularity-aware evaluation suite for open-world video segmentation. Built on a Granularity-Agnostic (GA) matching protocol, OGA relaxes conventional 1:1 matching to an n:1 mapping, but still enforces temporal rigor by detecting support discontinuities through sever points and scoring each reference object through its dominant coherent fragment. This prevents fragmented or flickering support from being over-rewarded while enabling GA-adapted metrics and structural diagnostics: identity persistence (IP), and identity concentration (IC). On VIPSeg, we show that standard 1:1 evaluation substantially underestimates open-world methods, whereas GA evaluation recovers much of their suppressed performance. On the more realistic long-horizon benchmarks: ScanNet and HM3D, Savvy consistently outperforms strong baselines across both classical and proposed metrics, including STQ, VPQ$_\infty$, IP and IC. Together, these results establish a practical benchmark and a strong baseline for open-world long-horizon video segmentation.

AI.title_translation: 开放世界视频分割
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Savvy视频分割系统和OGA评估协议，解决了长视频中物体发现和评估机制不合理的问题，显著提升了开放世界场景下的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分割方法局限于短视频和闭集基准，缺乏对长视频动态场景中物体发现和身份维护的支持，且现有的1:1匹配评估协议对不同粒度的语义预测存在不公平的惩罚。
AI.method: 提出Savvy系统：包含分层掩码发现、延迟准入和轨迹整合；提出OGA评估套件：采用粒度无关(GA)的n:1匹配协议，并引入身份持久性(IP)和身份集中度(IC)指标。
AI.result: 在VIPSeg上，GA评估恢复了被低估的性能；在ScanNet和HM3D长视频基准上，Savvy在各项指标（STQ, VPQ_∞, IP, IC）上均显著优于现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: Savvy系统和OGA评估套件为开放世界长视频分割提供了一个高效的基准和评估标准，证明了其在处理长序列动态场景下的优越性。
AI.translation: 尽管视频分割在短视频和闭集基准测试中取得了快速进展，但开放世界视频分割仍未得到充分探索。其挑战在于：(1) 现有方法不支持动态自我运动长视频中的物体发现和身份维护；(2) 现有评估协议依赖于刚性的1:1匹配，这对具有不匹配粒度的语义有效预测造成了不公平的惩罚。为了解决这两个差距，我们推出了Savvy，这是一个用于零样本开放世界长程视频分割的实用且强大的系统。Savvy结合了分层掩码发现、延迟准入和轨迹整合，以支持持久的物体发现、安全的轨迹提升和稳定的长程身份维护。我们进一步提出了OGA，这是一个用于开放世界视频分割的粒度感知评估套件。基于粒度无关（GA）匹配协议，OGA将传统的1:1匹配放宽为n:1映射，但仍通过切分点检测支持不连续性来强制执行时间严谨性，并通过其主导的连贯片段对每个参考对象进行评分。这防止了碎片化或闪烁的支持被过度奖励，同时实现了GA自适应指标和结构诊断：身份持久性（IP）和身份集中度（IC）。在VIPSeg上，我们展示了标准的1:1评估大大低估了开放世界方法，而GA评估恢复了它们大部分被抑制的性能。在更现实的长程基准测试ScanNet和HM3D上，Savvy在经典指标和所提指标（包括STQ、VPQ_∞、IP和IC）上始终优于强大的基线。总之，这些结果为开放世界长程视频分割建立了一个实用的基准和一个强大的基线。
AI.summary: 针对开放世界长视频分割面临的物体发现与评估不公问题，本文提出了Savvy分割系统和OGA评估套件。Savvy通过分层处理实现稳定的长程身份维护，而OGA通过粒度无关的匹配协议修正了传统评估的偏差，有效提升了长视频分割任务的衡量准确性。
AI.keywords: 开放世界视频分割, 长视频理解, 零样本学习, 粒度感知评估, 目标追踪
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了针对开放世界长视频分割的完整系统和评估框架，解决了传统1:1匹配机制无法处理多粒度语义预测的问题，对于推动自动驾驶、机器人视觉等领域的发展具有重要意义。

title: Formalizing and Mitigating Structural Distortion in LLM Attention for Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). However, applying LLMs to graphs requires linearizing their structure into sequences, introducing distortion rooted in the graph bandwidth problem. While this distortion has been shown to degrade performance, it is often attributed to prompt design or model scale, leaving the underlying mechanism unclear. In this work, we show \textit{how} rotary positional embeddings turn graph linearization into bandwidth-dependent attention decay, suppressing attention between graph-adjacent nodes that are forced far apart in the serialized sequence. This shifts the focus of LLM-based graph reasoning from prompt engineering and scaling toward correcting attention misalignment. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \textbf{G}raph-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{GaLA}), a lightweight, inference-time modification for LLMs. GaLA biases attention toward graph-adjacent nodes while preserving the LLM's sequential inductive biases. Across TAG benchmarks, GaLA improves performance with negligible overhead, demonstrating that distortion is a correctable bottleneck in LLM-based graph reasoning.

title: Configuration Smells in AGENTS.md Files: Common Mistakes in Configuring Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents are increasingly used to automate software engineering tasks. To guide their behavior, these agents commonly rely on configuration files, typically named AGENTS.‌md or CLAUDE.‌md, which provide instructions about architecture, workflows, coding conventions, and testing practices. Despite their growing importance, little is known about common problems affecting the definition and maintenance of these files. In this paper, we present the first catalog of smells for coding-agent configuration files. To identify such smells, we first conducted a grey literature review and a repository mining analysis. As a result, we identified six configuration smells and proposed automated heuristics to detect them. To evaluate the prevalence of the proposed smells, we analyzed 100 popular open-source repositories containing either an AGENTS.‌md or a CLAUDE.‌md file. Our results show that configuration smells are widespread. Lint Leakage was the most common smell, affecting 62% of the files, followed by Context Bloat (42%) and Skill Leakage (35%). We further show that several smells frequently co-occur, particularly Context Bloat, Skill Leakage, and Conflicting Instructions.

title: GRACE-DS: a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science
summary: We introduce GRACE-DS, a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science for pre-deployment evaluation of LLM-powered AutoML agents. GRACE-DS is a set of evaluation metrics in an isolated environment that can be applied to tabular ML tasks specific to a particular organization. It exposes agents to realistic workflow stages, from planning and data inspection through feature engineering, model development, validation, and code repair to final submission, while hidden executable validators measure not only final predictive performance but also leakage avoidance, reproducibility, protocol validity, correction behavior, and reward alignment. The strongest structured regime, flexible iterative interaction (our approach), achieves higher end-to-end normalized hidden-test quality than single-shot generation, unstructured interaction, and restart-based baselines, while also improving protocol-valid completion. Validated across more than 7,000 episodes, these results establish GRACE-DS as a robust platform for assessing the capacity of LLM-based AutoML agents to execute machine learning workflows under production-like conditions and in accordance with organization-specific requirements.

AI.title_translation: GRACE-DS：数据科学中一种受保护的奖励引导智能体纠正环境
AI.tldr: GRACE-DS 是一套用于评估大模型 AutoML 智能体的框架，通过模拟真实工作流及多维验证，证明了迭代交互比单次生成更适合处理复杂的机器学习任务。
AI.motivation: 为了解决当前大模型驱动的 AutoML 智能体在预部署阶段缺乏有效、全面的评估机制，且难以满足真实生产环境中对数据泄露、可复现性及合规性等严格要求的问题。
AI.method: 开发了 GRACE-DS 评估环境，通过隐藏的可执行验证器，在表格数据 ML 任务的多个工作流阶段（规划、特征工程、建模、验证、代码修复等）对智能体进行评估，并采用了灵活的迭代交互机制进行任务优化。
AI.result: 在超过 7,000 次实验中，GRACE-DS 表明其采用的“灵活迭代交互”方法在端到端归一化测试质量和协议合规完成率方面，均优于单次生成、非结构化交互及基于重启的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GRACE-DS 为评估大模型驱动的 AutoML 智能体提供了一个鲁棒的平台，验证了灵活的迭代交互机制在提升任务完成质量和协议合规性方面的显著优势。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 GRACE-DS，这是一个用于数据科学中大模型驱动的 AutoML 智能体预部署评估的“受保护奖励引导智能体纠正环境”。GRACE-DS 是一套应用于特定组织表格 ML 任务的隔离环境中的评估指标。它使智能体暴露于真实的工作流阶段，从规划和数据检查到特征工程、模型开发、验证、代码修复直至最终提交，同时隐藏的可执行验证器不仅测量最终的预测性能，还测量泄露规避、可复现性、协议有效性、纠正行为和奖励对齐。最强大的结构化方案——灵活的迭代交互（我们的方法）——实现了比单次生成、非结构化交互和基于重启的基线更高的端到端归一化隐藏测试质量，同时也提高了符合协议的完成率。通过超过 7,000 次实验验证，这些结果确立了 GRACE-DS 作为一个鲁棒的平台，用于评估基于大模型的 AutoML 智能体在类似生产条件下并根据组织特定要求执行机器学习工作流的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 GRACE-DS，一个针对大模型驱动的 AutoML 智能体的预部署评估环境。通过在隔离环境中模拟真实的数据科学工作流，并结合多维度的隐藏验证器，该框架能够全面评估智能体在预测性能、合规性及纠错能力上的表现。研究表明，灵活的迭代交互策略显著提升了智能体在复杂生产任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: AutoML, 大语言模型, 智能体评估, 机器学习工作流, 奖励导向纠错
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入一种受控且具有奖励导向的纠错环境，解决了大模型在自动化机器学习（AutoML）任务中难以在真实生产环境中落地的问题。其创新点在于将预测性能与合规性、可复现性等工程指标相结合，为评估AI智能体提供了一个标准化框架。

title: Calibrated Sampling-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Bayesian Deep Learning
summary: Modern deep learning models remain notoriously prone to overconfidence, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Bayesian methods aim to counter this by learning a distribution over model parameters, and recent advances now make this feasible for large-scale architectures at costs comparable to AdamW. However, a challenge remains at test time: predictions must be averaged across many forward passes with weights sampled from the posterior, which is prohibitively expensive. Variance propagation offers an efficient alternative, computing layer-wise analytical approximations of uncertainty in a single forward pass. While such techniques are effective for MLPs, their extension to modern architectures remains challenging, due to increased depth and diversity of layer types. To fill this gap, we propose Calibrated Variance Propagation (CVP), which introduces a new propagation method for normalization layers, combines it with recent techniques for handling activation functions, and absorbs residual error through a light calibration step. CVP yields comparably accurate uncertainty estimates to MC sampling across transformers and CNNs, at a fraction of the cost. Against prior variance propagation work, CVP improves coverage at $0.5\%$ risk from $8.2\%$ to $14.6\%$ with BEiT-3 on Visual Reasoning (NLVR2) and from $2.6\%$ to $10.8\%$ with ViLT on VQAv2, with gains extending to convolutional architectures.

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯深度学习中无采样校准的不确定性估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CVP的方法，通过方差传播和轻量级校准，在无需多次采样的情况下，以极低的计算成本实现高效且准确的贝叶斯不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯深度学习模型在测试阶段需要多次采样（MC sampling），计算成本过高，而现有的方差传播方法难以扩展到现代深层网络架构。
AI.method: 提出了校准方差传播（CVP）方法，包括针对归一化层的新型传播技术、处理激活函数的现有技术，以及通过轻量级校准步骤吸收残差误差。
AI.result: CVP在Transformer和CNN架构上实现了与MC采样相当的准确度，同时计算成本更低；在BEiT-3和ViLT等模型上，显著改善了特定风险下的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: CVP通过分析性方差传播与轻量级校准相结合，在不牺牲不确定性估计准确性的前提下，实现了比蒙特卡洛采样更高效的推理，为高风险应用中的模型可靠性提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 现代深度学习模型因过度自信而闻名，这限制了其在高风险应用中的可靠性。贝叶斯方法旨在通过学习模型参数的分布来应对这一问题，最近的进展使得在大规模架构上实现这一点成为可能，且成本与AdamW相当。然而，在测试阶段仍存在挑战：预测必须在从后验分布中采样的多个权重下进行平均，这极其昂贵。方差传播提供了一种高效的替代方案，可以在单次前向传递中计算逐层的不确定性分析近似。虽然这些技术对MLP有效，但由于深度增加和层类型多样，将其扩展到现代架构仍然具有挑战性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了校准方差传播（CVP），它引入了一种针对归一化层的新传播方法，将其与处理激活函数的近期技术相结合，并通过轻量级校准步骤吸收残差。CVP在Transformers和CNNs上产生了与MC采样相当准确的不确定性估计，且成本仅为后者的一小部分。与之前的方差传播工作相比，CVP在BEiT-3的视觉推理（NLVR2）上将0.5%风险下的覆盖率从8.2%提高到14.6%，在ViLT的VQAv2上从2.6%提高到10.8%，且这些收益延伸到了卷积架构。
AI.summary: 本文针对贝叶斯深度学习推理阶段计算开销大的问题，提出了一种名为“校准方差传播”（CVP）的高效方法。该方法通过改进归一化层和激活函数的分析性不确定性传播，并结合轻量级校准，实现了在现代深层架构（如Transformer和CNN）中以单次前向传递获得高质量的不确定性估计。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯深度学习, 不确定性估计, 方差传播, 模型校准, 高效推理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种无需多次采样即可进行不确定性估计的方法（CVP），有效解决了贝叶斯深度学习在推理阶段计算成本过高的问题。通过对标准化层和激活函数的处理以及轻量级校准，该方法在保持高精度的同时显著提升了计算效率，在Transformer和CNN架构上表现优异，具有很高的实用价值。

title: SpecAlign: Efficient Specification-Grounded Alignment of Large Language Models via Synthetic Data
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, alignment is no longer governed by a single universal notion of safety or helpfulness, but instead by provider- or application-specific model specifications. These specifications are typically long, structured, and frequently updated, yet existing alignment pipelines lack a systematic mechanism to operationalize them as training signals. In this paper, we propose specification-grounded alignment, a new alignment paradigm that treats provider-authored model specifications as the primary alignment target rather than abstract principles or static benchmarks. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce SpecAlign, a framework that synthesizes alignment data directly from specification documents. SpecAlign combines structured rule annotation, controllable specification instantiation, and multi-agent adversarial data synthesis to generate fine-grained, boundary-aware preference pairs that capture both compliant behaviors and meaningful specification violations. Experiments across multiple model specifications and backbone models demonstrate that training with SpecAlign consistently improves rule compliance while preserving general capabilities and avoiding over-conservative behavior. These results suggest that grounding alignment in explicit model specifications enables rapid, precise, and scalable adaptation of LLM behavior to evolving policy requirements.

title: Evolution & Foundation: AI Shares Creative Control
summary:
This paper investigates the creative process of automated design and artistic evaluation using an evolutionary system. We consider how a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) model can communicate and guide a combined generative and evolutionary computational system. This creates a framework for the evolution of aesthetically pleasing complex 3D organic forms by integrating genetic algorithms with the visual reasoning capabilities of large-scale AI foundation models.
  The framework shifts the artist role from that of intensive direct selection to one of system design; transferring detailed step-by-step curation to an AI agent capable of multimodal aesthetic judgement. This framework enables the human artist/designer to rapidly traverse large areas of multi-dimensional evolutionary parameter space to find creative outcomes based on their semantic targets.
  Detailed audit trails of the AI's aesthetic reasoning are generated for each experiment. Interactive visualisation tools, together with AI-generated summaries and evolutionary narratives, enable deep exploration into each evolutionary experiment and providing a transparent insight into the AI-guided process.

AI.title_translation: 进化与基础：AI共享创作控制权
AI.tldr: 通过将多模态AI与遗传算法结合，该框架实现了AI辅助的3D形态进化设计，将艺术家的角色从繁琐的选择中解放出来，并提供了透明的AI审美决策分析。

AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个人机协作框架，通过AI驱动进化过程，显著提升了复杂3D有机形态的设计效率，并增强了生成过程的透明度。
AI.translation: 本文研究了使用进化系统进行自动化设计和艺术评估的创作过程。我们考虑了多模态人工智能（AI）模型如何与生成式和进化式计算系统相结合进行交流和引导。通过将遗传算法与大规模AI基础模型的视觉推理能力集成，构建了一个用于进化美学复杂的3D有机形态的框架。该框架将艺术家的角色从密集的直接选择转变为系统设计；将详细的逐步策展工作转移给具备多模态审美判断能力的AI代理。这一框架使人类艺术家/设计师能够快速遍历多维进化参数空间，根据语义目标找到创意成果。每个实验都生成了AI审美推理的详细审计追踪。交互式可视化工具，连同AI生成的摘要和进化叙事，使得对每个进化实验的深入探索成为可能，并提供了对AI引导过程的透明洞察。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一个整合遗传算法与多模态AI基础模型的进化设计框架。该系统将艺术家的角色从直接选择转变为系统设计者，利用AI进行审美判断和参数空间遍历，从而高效生成复杂的3D有机形态，并通过审计追踪确保过程透明。
AI.keywords: 进化计算, 多模态人工智能, 3D有机形态, 人机协作, 审美评估
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大模型（Foundation Models）的视觉推理能力与遗传算法相结合，实现了从“人工选择”到“AI辅助策展”的范式转移。其重要性在于提升了复杂3D模型生成的效率与可解释性，但局限性在于过于依赖AI的审美判断，可能导致生成结果的同质化。

title: Polynomial-Time Riesz-Energy Subset Selection for Ordered Point Sets on Lines and $\ell_1$-Staircases
comments: 17pages, 6 Figures added appendix with more examples and explanations, and l1 staircase example, html friendly
summary: We study fixed-cardinality minimum Riesz $s$-energy subset selection for ordered point sets on the real line. Given $x_1<\cdots<x_n$, an exponent $s>0$, and a cardinality $k$, the task is to choose $1\leq i_1<\cdots<i_k\leq n$ minimizing $E_s(i_1,\ldots,i_k)=\sum_{1\leq p<q\leq k}(x_{i_q}-x_{i_p})^{-s}$. We prove that the one-dimensional Riesz interaction satisfies a Monge inequality. When feasible subsets are encoded as increasing index vectors, this property implies submodularity on a finite distributive lattice and yields polynomial-time solvability by submodular minimization over such lattices. The structural reduction holds for every real $s>0$; We also derive an explicit minimum $S$--$T$ min cut formulation with $k(n-k)$ threshold variables and $O(k^2(n-k)^2)$ finite pairwise edges. The constructed graph has $N=k(n-k)$ nodes and $M=O(k^2(n-k)^2)$ arcs after an $O(k^2(n-k)^2)$ coefficient-construction step; an $O(NM)$ max-flow bound gives an $O(k^3(n-k)^3)$ cut step, while the conservative $O(N^2M)$ bound gives $O(k^4(n-k)^4)$. By an isometry, the same algorithm applies to $\ell_1$-staircases, including monotone two-dimensional Pareto-front and skyline approximations. The report is accompanied by an open-source Python implementation of the proposed exact algorithm and an appendix with examples and detailed explanations of the underlying theory.

AI.title_translation: 基于直线和l1阶梯上排序点集的多项式时间Riesz能量子集选择
AI.tldr: 本文证明了有序点集上的Riesz能量最小化子集选择问题可以通过子模最小化在多项式时间内精确求解，并提供了高效的最小割算法和代码实现。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决有序点集（如实线上的点或l1阶梯）中，寻找具有给定基数且Riesz s-能量最小的子集的计算难题。
AI.method: 利用Riesz相互作用满足Monge不等式的性质，将问题建模为定义在有限分配格上的子模最小化问题，并通过构建显式的S-T最小割图进行求解。
AI.result: 证明了该问题具有多项式时间解，并给出了复杂度为O(k^3(n-k)^3)的最小割算法，同时将该方法推广至l1阶梯及二维帕累托前沿近似。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明了有序点集上固定基数的最小Riesz能量子集选择问题可以通过子模最小化在多项式时间内精确求解，并提供了具体的最小割图构建方案及开源实现。
AI.translation: 我们研究了实线上有序点集的固定基数最小Riesz s-能量子集选择问题。给定x1<...<xn，指数s>0，以及基数k，任务是选择1<=i1<...<ik<=n以最小化E_s(i1,...,ik)=sum_{1<=p<q<=k}(xi_q-xi_p)^(-s)。我们证明了一维Riesz相互作用满足Monge不等式。当可行子集被编码为递增索引向量时，该性质意味着有限分配格上的子模性，并可通过该格上的子模最小化实现多项式时间求解。这种结构归约适用于所有实数s>0；我们还导出了一个显式的S-T最小割公式，具有k(n-k)个阈值变量和O(k^2(n-k)^2)个有限成对边。构建的图在O(k^2(n-k)^2)系数构建步骤后，具有N=k(n-k)个节点和M=O(k^2(n-k)^2)条弧；O(NM)最大流界给出了O(k^3(n-k)^3)的割步骤，而保守的O(N^2M)界给出了O(k^4(n-k)^4)。通过等距变换，相同的算法适用于l1阶梯，包括单调二维帕累托前沿和天际线近似。报告附带了所提精确算法的开源Python实现，以及包含示例和底层理论详细解释的附录。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有序点集上最小Riesz s-能量子集选择问题。通过证明Riesz相互作用满足Monge不等式，研究人员展示了该问题可转化为有限分配格上的子模最小化问题，从而实现了多项式时间求解。此外，论文还给出了具体的最小割图构建方法，并将其应用扩展至l1阶梯和帕累托前沿近似，同时提供了开源算法实现。
AI.keywords: Riesz能量, 子集选择, 子模最小化, Monge不等式, 帕累托前沿
AI.comments: 该论文通过证明一维Riesz相互作用满足Monge不等式，成功地将这一复杂的组合优化问题转化为多项式时间可解的子模最小化问题。这一理论上的突破使得原本困难的离散能量最小化问题变得高效可解，在几何近似和帕累托前沿分析中具有重要应用价值。

title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
summary: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals for downstream robot control. This is achieved through a three-part design: a) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding, where a 60-layer double-stream diffusion transformer couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention; b) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK), an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames) with action-language mapping over 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories; and c) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum, a two-stage training strategy that first learns general visual priors and then injects embodied specialization under a shared language interface. Extensive results show strong competitiveness: ranks 1st overall on EWMBench and DreamGen Bench, outperforms all open-source models on WorldModelBench and PBench. Additional zero-shot analyses on RoboTwin-IF benchmark further support robust generalization and multi-view consistency.

AI.title_translation: Qwen-RobotWorld 技术报告：通过语言条件视频生成统一具身世界建模
AI.tldr: Qwen-RobotWorld 通过将语言作为统一接口并结合大规模视频数据集，构建了一个能预测多场景视觉轨迹的强大具身世界模型。
AI.motivation: 解决当前具身智能领域缺乏统一的动作接口和跨场景世界建模能力的问题，旨在通过语言条件视频生成实现机器人对物理世界未来轨迹的准确预测与规划。
AI.method: 1. 采用双流MMDiT架构，通过层级联合注意力机制耦合Qwen2.5-VL语义与视频VAE潜变量；2. 构建包含860万视频-文本对的具身世界知识库(EWK)；3. 实施通用到专家级的两阶段渐进式训练策略。
AI.result: Qwen-RobotWorld 在 EWMBench 和 DreamGen Bench 上排名第一，在 WorldModelBench 和 PBench 上超越所有开源模型，并在 RoboTwin-IF 零样本测试中表现出强大的泛化性和多视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-RobotWorld 证明了语言条件视频生成是实现通用具身智能世界模型的有效路径，通过统一的语言接口实现了跨平台、跨任务的物理世界预测与规划。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 Qwen-RobotWorld，这是一个用于具身智能的语言条件视频世界模型。它以自然语言作为统一的动作接口，根据当前观测预测机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航以及人机迁移等场景下具有物理基础的未来视觉轨迹。这种统一的表述提供了三个有前景的应用方向：用于策略训练增强的合成数据生成、用于策略评估的可扩展虚拟环境，以及用于下游机器人控制的语言引导规划信号。这通过三部分设计实现：a) 带有 MLLM 动作编码的双流 MMDiT，其中 60 层双流扩散 Transformer 通过逐层联合注意力将冻结的 Qwen2.5-VL 语义与视频 VAE 潜变量耦合；b) 具身世界知识 (EWK)，一个包含 8.6M 视频-文本语料库（2 亿多帧），涵盖 20 多种具身和 500 多种动作类别的动作-语言映射；c) 通用+专家渐进式课程，这是一种两阶段训练策略，首先学习通用视觉先验，然后在共享语言接口下注入具身专业化能力。广泛的结果显示出极强的竞争力：在 EWMBench 和 DreamGen Bench 上总排名第一，在 WorldModelBench 和 PBench 上优于所有开源模型。对 RoboTwin-IF 基准的额外零样本分析进一步支持了其稳健的泛化性和多视角一致性。
AI.summary: Qwen-RobotWorld 是一个用于具身智能的语言条件视频世界模型，它将自然语言作为统一的动作接口，通过预测视觉轨迹来支持机器人操作、自动驾驶和室内导航等任务。该模型通过创新的双流扩散Transformer架构、大规模具身知识库和渐进式训练策略，实现了高性能的视觉预测与规划能力。
AI.keywords: 具身智能, 世界模型, 视频生成, 语言引导, 机器人控制
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建大规模具身世界知识库和创新的双流扩散Transformer架构，成功将不同具身智能场景统一在语言建模框架下。其核心贡献在于证明了通过语言条件视频生成可以有效解决复杂机器人任务中的环境建模与规划问题，在多个基准测试中表现卓越，具有很高的学术与应用价值。

title: Shift-Left High-Level Synthesis Verification via Knowledge-Augmented LLM Agent
summary: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) relies on transforming original C specifications into synthesizable HLS-oriented C (HLS-C) implementations. Functional consistency verification between original C specifications and HLS-C implementations is a critical yet labor-intensive task in HLS design flows. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in automated testbench generation, their stochastic nature often leads to insufficient coverage, inconsistent verification environments, and unreliable equivalence checking results. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-augmented, agent-driven shift-left verification framework for automated functional consistency checking between original C and HLS-C implementations before synthesis. The framework introduces a Dual-Tier Consistency Checking mechanism that jointly enforces static structural alignment and dynamic behavioral equivalence between paired testbenches, while integrating symbolic execution and coverage-driven refinement to improve verification completeness. Furthermore, we construct a heterogeneous HLS Verification Knowledge Graph to provide topology-aware reasoning priors for testbench generation, and design an autonomous verification agent to orchestrate iterative refinement and failure diagnosis across heterogeneous toolchains. Experimental results on 107 HLS benchmark pairs demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves 0.9826 average coverage and 0.9533 dynamic consistency, outperforming representative AST-based, retrieval-augmented, and iterative agent-based baselines. https://github.com/cz-5f/HLS-LeVeri.git

AI.title_translation: 基于知识增强LLM智能体的HLS左移验证技术
AI.tldr: 通过引入知识图谱与自主智能体，该方法解决了大模型在HLS设计验证中覆盖率低和可靠性差的问题，显著提升了验证效率。
AI.motivation: HLS设计中C规范与HLS-C实现之间的功能一致性验证极其耗时且困难，而现有的LLM方法存在覆盖率不足、验证环境不一致及结果不可靠等局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种知识增强的智能体驱动验证框架，包含：1. 双层一致性检查机制（静态结构对齐与动态行为等价）；2. 符号执行与覆盖率驱动的细化；3. 构建HLS验证知识图谱以提供推理先验；4. 自主验证智能体负责迭代细化与故障诊断。
AI.result: 在107个HLS基准测试对上，该框架实现了0.9826的平均覆盖率和0.9533的动态一致性，表现优于现有的AST、检索增强及迭代智能体基准。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过知识增强的智能体架构，显著提升了HLS设计中C与HLS-C实现之间功能一致性验证的覆盖率与准确性。
AI.translation: 高层次综合（HLS）依赖于将原始C规范转换为可综合的HLS专用C（HLS-C）实现。在HLS设计流程中，原始C规范与HLS-C实现之间的功能一致性验证是一项关键但繁重的工作。虽然大语言模型（LLMs）最近在自动化测试平台生成方面显示出潜力，但其随机性往往导致覆盖率不足、验证环境不一致以及等价性检查结果不可靠。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种知识增强、智能体驱动的左移验证框架，用于在综合前自动检查原始C与HLS-C实现之间的功能一致性。该框架引入了双层一致性检查机制，共同强制执行配对测试平台之间的静态结构对齐和动态行为等价，同时集成了符号执行和覆盖率驱动的细化以提高验证完整性。此外，我们构建了一个异构HLS验证知识图谱，为测试平台生成提供拓扑感知推理先验，并设计了一个自主验证智能体来协调跨异构工具链的迭代细化和故障诊断。在107个HLS基准测试对上的实验结果表明，该框架实现了0.9826的平均覆盖率和0.9533的动态一致性，优于现有的基于AST、检索增强和基于迭代智能体的基准方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于知识增强LLM智能体的HLS验证框架（HLS-LeVeri），通过构建验证知识图谱和双层一致性检查机制，结合符号执行与自主迭代细化，实现了高效、高覆盖率的C与HLS-C功能一致性验证。
AI.keywords: 高层次综合 (HLS), 大语言模型 (LLM), 功能验证, 知识图谱, 智能体框架
AI.comments: 该研究通过知识图谱与智能体技术的结合，有效解决了传统LLM在硬件验证中随机性高、覆盖率不足的问题，为自动化硬件设计验证提供了新思路。其创新点在于将符号执行与知识图谱引入HLS验证流程，具有很高的工程实用价值。

title: Not Truly Multilingual: Script Consistency as a Missing Dimension in VLM Evaluation
summary: Current multilingual evaluations for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) assume a one-to-one mapping between language and orthography, overlooking billions of users of multi-script languages. We introduce PuMVR (Punjabi Multimodal Visual Reasoning), a benchmark of 1,000 strictly parallel image-text instances across Punjabi's three active scripts: Gurmukhi, Shahmukhi, and Roman. Evaluating 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we expose a substantial and systematic Script Gap. Models frequently solve visual tasks in one script while failing identical tasks in another, with accuracy deltas reaching 16%. Crucially, visual input boosts absolute performance uniformly yet does not close the orthographic gap. Furthermore, cross-script in-context transfer is highly brittle, exposing script-locked knowledge representation. Supported by McNemar tests across all script pairs, our findings demonstrate that current "multilingual" VLMs are not truly multi-script. We propose the Script Consistency Rate (SCR), which falls as low as 24.8% on our benchmark, as a mandatory metric for script-agnostic evaluation to ensure equitable AI access. Data and code are available at: https://github.com/prabhjotschugh/Not-Truly-Multilingual-PuMVR.

AI.title_translation: 并非真正的多语言：脚本一致性作为VLM评估中缺失的维度
AI.tldr: 研究发现当前多语言视觉语言模型存在显著的“脚本差距”，在处理同一语言的不同书写系统时表现不一，作者提出了新的评估指标SCR以推动更公平的AI开发。
AI.motivation: 当前的多语言VLM评估错误地假设语言与书写系统是一一对应的，忽视了多脚本语言使用者的需求，导致模型在处理同一语言不同脚本时表现出巨大的性能差异。
AI.method: 构建了包含1000个严格并行图文实例的Punjabi多脚本基准测试（PuMVR），涵盖Gurmukhi、Shahmukhi和Roman三种脚本；对10个前沿VLM进行评估，并提出了脚本一致性率（SCR）指标。
AI.result: 实验发现模型存在显著的“脚本差距”，性能差异高达16%；视觉输入虽能提升性能但无法消除脚本差距；跨脚本上下文迁移能力极弱，表现出脚本锁定的知识表征特征。SCR指标最低仅为24.8%。
AI.conclusion: 现有的多语言VLM并非真正意义上的多脚本模型，存在显著的脚本偏见。脚本一致性评价（SCR）应成为未来评估模型公平性和多语言能力的关键指标。
AI.translation: 当前针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的多语言评估通常假设语言与书写系统之间存在一一对应关系，这忽视了数十亿使用多脚本语言的用户。我们引入了PuMVR（Punjabi多模态视觉推理），这是一个包含1000个严格并行图文实例的基准测试，涵盖了Punjabi的三种活跃脚本：Gurmukhi、Shahmukhi和Roman。通过对10个最先进的VLM进行评估，我们揭示了存在实质性且系统性的“脚本差距”。模型经常能解决一种脚本下的视觉任务，却在另一种脚本下的相同任务中失败，准确率差异高达16%。至关重要的是，视觉输入虽然统一提升了绝对性能，但并未缩小正字法差距。此外，跨脚本的上下文迁移非常脆弱，暴露了脚本锁定的知识表征。通过对所有脚本对进行McNemar检验，我们的研究结果表明，当前的“多语言”VLM并非真正意义上的多脚本模型。我们提出了脚本一致性率（SCR），该指标在我们的基准测试中低至24.8%，并建议将其作为脚本不可知评估的强制性指标，以确保AI访问的公平性。数据和代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/prabhjotschugh/Not-Truly-Multilingual-PuMVR。
AI.summary: 本文针对多语言视觉语言模型（VLM）评估中忽视多脚本语言的问题，提出了Punjabi多脚本基准测试（PuMVR）。通过评估10个前沿模型，揭示了模型在处理同一语言的不同脚本时存在显著的性能差异（脚本差距），并提出脚本一致性率（SCR）作为评估模型多脚本公平性的必要指标。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 多语言评估, 脚本一致性, Punjabi, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究指出当前多语言视觉语言模型（VLM）在评估中严重忽视了“多脚本”这一维度，这是一个重要的发现，因为它揭示了模型知识表征的局限性。通过引入Punjabi多脚本基准测试，该工作为提升AI系统的包容性和跨脚本能力提供了新的评价指标和研究范式。

title: On the Memorization Behavior of LLMs in Generative Recommendation: Observations, Implications, and Training Strategies
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising direction for recommender systems. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted for GR, as their rich pretrained knowledge is expected to help them generalize beyond common user behavior patterns that traditional memorization-oriented baselines can capture. However, existing LLM-based GR works largely ignore LLMs' well-known tendency to memorize, which, if present in LLMs fine-tuned for GR, would restrict their utilization of pretrained knowledge. In this work, we investigate this concern by examining one-hop memorization, where a model recommends items that are direct successors of items in the training data. We show that LLMs do this more than non-LLM-based GR models-in fact, the vast majority of their gains over GR baselines are actually on users whose target items can be predicted through one-hop memorization. We intuit that improving performance on the remaining users requires LLMs to learn richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions. To achieve this, we propose IIRG, a novel training strategy that teaches LLMs to capture: (1) collaborative relations derived from item co-occurrences across multiple hops in user sequences, and (2) semantic relations among items with similar themes, both of which can serve as useful recommendation signals. We show that IIRG significantly improves over LLMs trained solely with standard next-item prediction, with especially large gains for users whose test items are not covered by train-time one-hop transitions.

AI.title_translation: 论生成式推荐中LLM的记忆行为：观察、启示与训练策略
AI.tldr: LLM在生成式推荐中过度依赖单跳记忆，本文提出IIRG训练策略，通过学习多跳协同和语义关系，提升模型的泛化推荐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的生成式推荐研究忽视了模型对训练数据的记忆倾向，导致其泛化能力受限，且表现提升主要依赖于简单的“单跳记忆”。
AI.method: 提出IIRG（Item-Item Relation-based Generation）训练策略，通过显式学习跨多跳的物品协同关系和基于主题的语义关系，增强模型对复杂物品关联的捕捉能力。
AI.result: 实验证明，LLM在推荐任务中表现出比传统模型更强的单跳记忆行为，且大部分性能增益来源于此。使用IIRG训练后，模型在未覆盖的测试样本上性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过IIRG训练策略引入多跳协同关系和语义关系，能够显著提升LLM在推荐任务中处理非记忆型用户的能力，超越了单纯的下一项预测。
AI.translation: 生成式推荐（GR）已成为推荐系统的一个重要发展方向。最近，大语言模型（LLMs）因其丰富的预训练知识被越来越多地应用于GR，有望超越传统记忆导向基线所能捕捉的常见用户行为模式。然而，现有的基于LLM的GR研究在很大程度上忽视了LLM众所周知的记忆倾向；如果这种倾向存在于为GR微调的LLM中，将限制其对预训练知识的利用。在这项工作中，我们通过检查“单跳记忆”（即模型推荐训练数据中物品的直接后继项）来研究这一问题。我们发现，LLM比非LLM的GR模型表现出更多的此类行为——事实上，它们相对于GR基线的大部分增益，实际上来自于那些可以通过单跳记忆预测目标物品的用户。我们直觉认为，提高剩余用户的性能需要LLM学习单跳转换之外更丰富的物品间关系。为此，我们提出了IIRG，这是一种创新的训练策略，旨在教会LLM捕捉：（1）从用户序列中跨多跳的物品共现中导出的协同关系，以及（2）具有相似主题的物品之间的语义关系，这两者都可以作为有用的推荐信号。我们证明了IIRG显著优于仅使用标准下一项预测训练的LLM，对于测试项未被训练时单跳转换覆盖的用户，其增益尤为显著。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在生成式推荐中的记忆行为，发现其性能提升主要源于对训练数据中单跳序列的记忆。为解决这一局限性，作者提出了IIRG训练策略，通过整合多跳协同关系和物品语义关系，引导LLM学习更深层的推荐逻辑，从而显著提升了模型的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐, 大语言模型, 记忆行为, 协同关系, 语义关系
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了LLM在生成式推荐任务中存在严重的“单跳记忆”倾向，这掩盖了其利用预训练知识的潜力。研究通过提出IIRG策略，有效地引导模型捕捉更复杂的语义和协同关系，为提升LLM推荐系统的泛化能力提供了重要参考。

title: Implicit vs. Explicit Prompting Strategies for LVLMs in Referential Communication
summary: Two recent studies (Jones et al. (2026); Zeng et al. (2026)) reach apparently contradictory conclusions about whether LVLMs can coordinate on efficient referring expressions. We control for task differences between the studies while directly comparing their prompting styles. We replicate the finding that models can coordinate efficient referring expressions when explicitly prompted to do so, suggesting that other task differences are not responsible for divergent results. However, we also find that the same models fail to infer the need for communicative efficiency from a more implicit prompt, highlighting critical differences between how humans and AI systems communicate.
