title: The complexity of being monitorable
summary: We study monitorable sets from a topological standpoint. In particular, we use descriptive set theory to describe the complexity of the family of monitorable sets in a countable space $X$. When $X$ is second countable, we observe that the family of monitorable sets is $Π^0_3$ and determine the exact complexities it can have. In contrast, we show that if $X$ is not second countable then the family of monitorable sets can be much more complex, giving an example where it is $ Π^1_1$-complete.

AI.title_translation: 可监控性的复杂性
AI.tldr: 本文通过拓扑学方法证明了可监控集的复杂度取决于空间是否为第二可数，其复杂度范围从 $\Pi^0_3$ 到 $\Pi^1_1$-完全不等。
AI.motivation: 旨在从拓扑学角度深入理解和刻画“可监控集”的复杂度，以弥补对该概念理论基础研究的不足。
AI.method: 利用描述集理论（Descriptive Set Theory）对可监控集族进行拓扑复杂性分析，并对比分析了第二可数空间与非第二可数空间的情况。
AI.result: 证明了在第二可数空间中，可监控集族为 $\Pi^0_3$；而在非第二可数空间中，其复杂度可能高达 $\Pi^1_1$-完全。
AI.conclusion: 可监控集的复杂度高度依赖于底层空间 $X$ 的拓扑性质，在第二可数空间中复杂度为 $\Pi^0_3$，而在非第二可数空间中可能达到 $\Pi^1_1$-完全。
AI.translation: 我们从拓扑学的角度研究了可监控集。特别地，我们使用描述集理论来描述可数空间 $X$ 中可监控集族的复杂性。当 $X$ 是第二可数空间时，我们观察到可监控集族是 $\Pi^0_3$ 的，并确定了它可能具有的确切复杂性。相比之下，我们证明了如果 $X$ 不是第二可数空间，那么可监控集族可能复杂得多，并给出了一个它是 $\Pi^1_1$-完全的例子。
AI.summary: 本文通过描述集理论研究了可监控集的拓扑性质，证明了其复杂度与底层空间是否为第二可数空间密切相关，并给出了相应的复杂度分级。
AI.keywords: 可监控集, 描述集理论, 拓扑复杂度, 第二可数空间, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该论文通过描述集理论对“可监控集”进行了深刻的拓扑学分类，明确了空间的可数性对复杂度的决定性影响，为形式化验证和监控理论提供了重要的理论基础。

title: SciHorizon-GENE: Benchmarking LLM for Life Sciences Inference from Gene Knowledge to Functional Understanding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing promise in biomedical research, particularly for knowledge-driven interpretation tasks. However, their ability to reliably reason from gene-level knowledge to functional understanding, a core requirement for knowledge-enhanced cell atlas interpretation, remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SciHorizon-GENE, a large-scale gene-centric benchmark constructed from authoritative biological databases. The benchmark integrates curated knowledge for over 190K human genes and comprises more than 540K questions covering diverse gene-to-function reasoning scenarios relevant to cell type annotation, functional interpretation, and mechanism-oriented analysis. Motivated by behavioral patterns observed in preliminary examinations, SciHorizon-GENE evaluates LLMs along four biologically critical perspectives: research attention sensitivity, hallucination tendency, answer completeness, and literature influence, explicitly targeting failure modes that limit the safe adoption of LLMs in biological interpretation pipelines. We systematically evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art general-purpose and biomedical LLMs, revealing substantial heterogeneity in gene-level reasoning capabilities and persistent challenges in generating faithful, complete, and literature-grounded functional interpretations. Our benchmark establishes a systematic foundation for analyzing LLM behavior at the gene scale and offers insights for model selection and development, with direct relevance to knowledge-enhanced biological interpretation.

AI.title_translation: SciHorizon-GENE：用于生命科学推理的大语言模型基准测试——从基因知识到功能理解
AI.tldr: 本文推出了 SciHorizon-GENE 基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在基因到功能推理任务中的准确性、幻觉和文献依赖性，揭示了当前模型在生物医学应用中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型在从基因知识到功能理解的推理能力方面缺乏深入评估，这限制了其在知识增强型细胞图谱解释等生物医学任务中的可靠应用。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含19万个基因和54万个问题的基因中心基准测试集，并从研究关注敏感度、幻觉倾向、答案完整性和文献影响力四个维度对主流大模型进行了系统性评估。
AI.result: 研究发现现有的大模型在基因级推理能力上存在显著差异，且在生成忠实、完整且基于文献的生物功能解释方面仍面临持续性挑战。
AI.conclusion: SciHorizon-GENE 揭示了当前主流大模型在基因功能推理方面的显著差异和局限性，为未来开发更可靠的生物医学推理模型提供了重要的基准和评估框架。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学研究中，特别是在知识驱动的解释任务中显示出越来越大的潜力。然而，它们从基因级知识推理到功能理解的能力（这是知识增强型细胞图谱解释的核心要求）仍未得到充分探索。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 SciHorizon-GENE，这是一个从权威生物数据库构建的大规模基因中心基准测试。该基准集成了超过19万个人类基因的策划知识，包含超过54万个问题，涵盖了与细胞类型注释、功能解释和面向机制分析相关的多种基因到功能推理场景。受初步检查中观察到的行为模式启发，SciHorizon-GENE 从四个生物学关键视角评估 LLMs：研究关注敏感度、幻觉倾向、答案完整性和文献影响力，明确针对限制 LLMs 在生物解释流程中安全采用的失效模式。我们系统地评估了广泛的先进通用和生物医学 LLMs，揭示了基因级推理能力的显著异质性，以及在生成忠实、完整和基于文献的功能解释方面存在的持续挑战。我们的基准测试为分析基因尺度下的 LLM 行为奠定了系统基础，并为模型选择和开发提供了见解，与知识增强的生物学解释直接相关。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SciHorizon-GENE，这是一个专门用于评估大语言模型在基因到功能推理任务中表现的大规模基准测试，旨在解决生物医学领域对LLM推理能力评估不足的问题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 生物医学, 基因推理, 基准测试, 功能解释
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建大规模基因基准测试，填补了LLM在生物医学推理领域评估的空白。其创新之处在于不仅关注准确率，还针对性地评估了模型的幻觉倾向和文献依赖性，这对生物医学领域的AI安全性至关重要。

title: DeepInflation: an AI agent for research and model discovery of inflation
summary: We present DeepInflation, an AI agent designed for research and model discovery in inflationary cosmology. Built upon a multi-agent architecture, DeepInflation integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with a symbolic regression (SR) engine and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) knowledge base. This framework enables the agent to automatically explore and verify the vast landscape of inflationary potentials while grounding its outputs in established theoretical literature. We demonstrate that DeepInflation can successfully discover simple and viable single-field slow-roll inflationary potentials consistent with the latest observations (with the ACT DR6 results taken as an example) or any given $n_s$ and $r$, and provide accurate theoretical context for obscure inflationary scenarios. DeepInflation serves as a prototype for a new generation of autonomous scientific discovery engines in cosmology, which enables researchers and non-experts alike to explore the inflationary landscape using natural language. This agent is available at https://github.com/pengzy-cosmo/DeepInflation.

title: The Leibniz adjunction in homotopy type theory, with an application to simplicial type theory
comments: v2: Minor updates to the terminology and exposition
summary: Simplicial type theory extends homotopy type theory and equips types with a notion of directed morphisms. A Segal type is defined to be a type in which these directed morphisms can be composed. We show that all higher coherences can be stated and derived if simplicial type theory is taken to be homotopy type theory with a postulated interval type. In technical terms, this means that if a type has unique fillers for $(2,1)$-horns, it has unique fillers for all inner $(n,k)$-horns. This generalizes a result of Riehl and Shulman for the case $n = 3, k \in \{1, 2\}$. Our main technical tool is the Leibniz adjunction: the pushout-product is left adjoint to the pullback-hom in the wild category of types. While this adjunction is well known for ordinary categories, it is much more involved for higher categories, and the fact that it can be proved for the wild category of types (a higher category without stated higher coherences) is non-trivial. We make profitable use of the equivalence between the wild category of maps and that of families. We have formalized the results in Cubical Agda.

title: LALM-as-a-Judge: Benchmarking Large Audio-Language Models for Safety Evaluation in Multi-Turn Spoken Dialogues
summary: Evaluation of socially unsafe content in spoken dialogues remains text-centric, missing prosody and transcription failures. We present LALM-as-a-Judge, which includes an open benchmark of 24,000 multi-turn spoken dialogues with one localized unsafe turn, generated out of 8 socially unsafe categories and 5 severity levels. We evaluate 6 large audio-language models (LALMs) as judges, open and closed-source, in text-only, audio-only, and multimodal setups by their sensitivity, severity-order specificity, and turn-position bias for socially harmful content in the dialogue. Results show that audio contributes non-lexical evidence beyond transcript semantics and that multimodal gains are not universal but can be text-anchored, balanced, conservative, and interfering, which we link to the audio pathway bottlenecks and fusion limits. We position the benchmark as diagnostic and derive practitioner guidance for model, modality, and prompts choices.

AI.title_translation: LALM-as-a-Judge：多轮语音对话中大音频语言模型安全评估的基准测试
AI.tldr: 提出了一项针对大音频语言模型在多轮语音对话中检测不安全内容的基准测试，揭示了音频模态在安全评估中的关键补充作用及其面临的融合挑战。
AI.motivation: 目前的社会不安全内容评估仍主要依赖文本，忽略了语音中的韵律特征及转录错误，导致对多轮语音对话的安全评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 构建包含24,000个多轮语音对话的基准测试集，涵盖8种社会不安全类别和5种严重程度；在文本、音频和多模态三种设置下，测试6种大音频语言模型作为“裁判”的表现，并分析其敏感度、严重程度排序特异性及转折位置偏见。
AI.result: 实验表明，音频信息能提供超越文本语义的非词汇性证据；多模态增益并非普适，受模型音频路径瓶颈和融合限制影响，表现出文本锚定、平衡、保守或干扰等多种效果。

AI.translation: 语音对话中社会不安全内容的评估目前仍以文本为中心，忽略了韵律和转录失败带来的影响。我们提出了LALM-as-a-Judge，包含一个由24,000个多轮语音对话组成的开放基准，这些对话涵盖了8种社会不安全类别和5种严重程度，且每段对话中包含一个局部的不安全轮次。我们评估了6种开源和闭源的大音频语言模型（LALMs）作为“裁判”，在纯文本、纯音频和多模态设置下，根据其对对话中社会危害内容的敏感度、严重程度排序特异性和转折位置偏见进行测试。结果表明，音频提供了超越转录语义的非词汇证据，且多模态的增益并非普适，而是可能呈现出文本锚定、平衡、保守或干扰等特征，我们将这些特征与音频路径瓶颈和融合限制联系起来。我们将该基准定位为诊断工具，并为模型、模态和提示词的选择提供了实践指导。

title: Anti-causal domain generalization: Leveraging unlabeled data
comments: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: The problem of domain generalization concerns learning predictive models that are robust to distribution shifts when deployed in new, previously unseen environments. Existing methods typically require labeled data from multiple training environments, limiting their applicability when labeled data are scarce. In this work, we study domain generalization in an anti-causal setting, where the outcome causes the observed covariates. Under this structure, environment perturbations that affect the covariates do not propagate to the outcome, which motivates regularizing the model's sensitivity to these perturbations. Crucially, estimating these perturbation directions does not require labels, enabling us to leverage unlabeled data from multiple environments. We propose two methods that penalize the model's sensitivity to variations in the mean and covariance of the covariates across environments, respectively, and prove that these methods have worst-case optimality guarantees under certain classes of environments. Finally, we demonstrate the empirical performance of our approach on a controlled physical system and a physiological signal dataset.

AI.title_translation: 反因果域泛化：利用无标签数据
AI.tldr: 在反因果设定下，通过利用无标签数据惩罚模型对环境扰动的敏感度，提升了域泛化模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的域泛化方法高度依赖多环境下的标注数据，而在标注数据稀缺时难以应用。作者试图利用反因果设定下的结构特性，通过无标签数据来增强模型的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出两种正则化方法，分别惩罚模型对跨环境协变量均值和协方差变化的敏感度，并利用无标签数据估计这些环境扰动方向。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在受控物理系统和生理信号数据集上表现良好，且理论上在特定环境下具有最差情况下的最优性保证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过在反因果设定下正则化模型对环境扰动的敏感度，有效提升了域泛化能力，并证明了在特定环境类别下的最差情况最优性。
AI.translation: 域泛化问题关注于学习在部署于新的、未见过的环境时，对分布偏移具有鲁棒性的预测模型。现有的方法通常需要来自多个训练环境的标注数据，这限制了它们在标注数据稀缺时的适用性。在这项工作中，我们研究了反因果设定下的域泛化问题，即结果导致观察到的协变量。在这种结构下，影响协变量的环境扰动不会传播到结果，这促使我们对模型对这些扰动的敏感性进行正则化。关键的是，估计这些扰动方向不需要标签，使我们能够利用来自多个环境的无标签数据。我们提出了两种方法，分别惩罚模型对跨环境协变量的均值和协方差变化的敏感性，并证明了这些方法在特定类别的环境下具有最差情况下的最优性保证。最后，我们在一个受控物理系统和一个生理信号数据集上展示了我们方法的实证性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对域泛化问题，在反因果设定下提出了一种利用无标签数据的方法。通过正则化模型对跨环境协变量变动的敏感性，实现了在数据稀缺场景下对分布偏移的鲁棒预测，并提供了理论最优性证明与实证支持。
AI.keywords: 域泛化, 反因果, 无监督学习, 鲁棒性, 分布偏移
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将因果推断框架（特别是反因果设定）引入域泛化问题，巧妙地利用了无标签数据来估计环境扰动，从而降低了对标注数据的依赖。这为数据稀缺场景下的模型鲁棒性提升提供了新思路。

title: Not Just How Much, But Where: Decomposing Epistemic Uncertainty into Per-Class Contributions
summary: In safety-critical classification, the cost of failure is often asymmetric, yet Bayesian deep learning summarises epistemic uncertainty with a single scalar, mutual information (MI), that cannot distinguish whether a model's ignorance involves a benign or safety-critical class. We decompose MI into a per-class vector $C_k(x)=σ_k^{2}/(2μ_k)$, with $μ_k{=}\mathbb{E}[p_k]$ and $σ_k^2{=}\mathrm{Var}[p_k]$ across posterior samples. The decomposition follows from a second-order Taylor expansion of the entropy; the $1/μ_k$ weighting corrects boundary suppression and makes $C_k$ comparable across rare and common classes. By construction $\sum_k C_k \approx \mathrm{MI}$, and a companion skewness diagnostic flags inputs where the approximation degrades. After characterising the axiomatic properties of $C_k$, we validate it on three tasks: (i) selective prediction for diabetic retinopathy, where critical-class $C_k$ reduces selective risk by 34.7\% over MI and 56.2\% over variance baselines; (ii) out-of-distribution detection on clinical and image benchmarks, where $\sum_k C_k$ achieves the highest AUROC and the per-class view exposes asymmetric shifts invisible to MI; and (iii) a controlled label-noise study in which $\sum_k C_k$ shows less sensitivity to injected aleatoric noise than MI under end-to-end Bayesian training, while both metrics degrade under transfer learning. Across all tasks, the quality of the posterior approximation shapes uncertainty at least as strongly as the choice of metric, suggesting that how uncertainty is propagated through the network matters as much as how it is measured.

AI.title_translation: 不仅仅是“多少”，而是“哪里”：将认知不确定性分解为每类贡献
AI.tldr: 本文提出将贝叶斯模型的不确定性分解为针对每个类别的贡献度，从而在安全关键应用中更精准地识别和评估风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的贝叶斯深度学习通常用单一的互信息标量来表示认知不确定性，无法区分模型对良性类别和安全关键类别的无知程度，导致在安全关键任务中表现不足。
AI.method: 通过对熵进行二阶泰勒展开，将互信息分解为每类贡献向量 $C_k(x)=σ_k^{2}/(2μ_k)$，并引入偏度诊断来评估近似质量。
AI.result: 在糖尿病视网膜病变预测中，该方法将选择性风险降低了34.7%（对比互信息）；在分布外检测中表现出最高AUROC；同时在标签噪声实验中显示出比互信息更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种将互信息分解为每类贡献的方法，能更精准地识别安全关键类别的模型不确定性，并在多个基准测试中优于现有的单一标量度量方法。
AI.translation: 在安全关键的分类任务中，失败的代价往往是不对称的，然而贝叶斯深度学习通常用单一的标量——互信息（MI）来总结认知不确定性，这无法区分模型的无知是涉及良性类别还是安全关键类别。我们通过后验样本的二阶泰勒展开，将MI分解为每类贡献向量 $C_k(x)=σ_k^{2}/(2μ_k)$（其中 $μ_k$ 和 $σ_k^2$ 分别为均值和方差）；$1/μ_k$ 的加权修正了边界抑制，使得 $C_k$ 在稀有类和常见类之间具有可比性。构造上满足 $\sum_k C_k \approx \mathrm{MI}$，并配备偏度诊断来标记近似失效的输入。在表征了 $C_k$ 的公理化属性后，我们在三项任务中进行了验证：(i) 糖尿病视网膜病变的选择性预测，关键类别的 $C_k$ 比 MI 降低了 34.7% 的选择性风险；(ii) 临床和图像基准上的分布外检测，$\sum_k C_k$ 实现了最高的 AUROC；(iii) 标签噪声研究，显示 $C_k$ 对偶然噪声的敏感度低于 MI。结果表明，不确定性如何在网络中传播与如何测量它同样重要。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将贝叶斯深度学习中的认知不确定性（互信息）分解为每类贡献向量的方法。通过泰勒展开，该方法能够揭示模型在特定类别上的不确定性，解决了单一标量无法区分关键类别风险的问题，并在临床和图像任务中验证了其在安全决策中的优越性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯深度学习, 认知不确定性, 互信息分解, 安全关键分类, 预测选择
AI.comments: 该研究通过将贝叶斯深度学习中的单一不确定性标量分解为类别贡献向量，有效地解决了安全关键任务中不确定性来源模糊的问题。其创新点在于利用泰勒展开导出了具有物理意义的度量指标，并证明了不确定性的传播方式与度量方式同样重要。局限性在于该方法依赖于后验分布的近似质量，且在迁移学习场景下表现有所下降。

title: Regular Fourier Features for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes
summary: Simulating a Gaussian process requires sampling from a high-dimensional Gaussian distribution, which scales cubically with the number of sample locations. Spectral methods address this challenge by exploiting the Fourier representation and treating the spectral density as a probability distribution suitable for Monte Carlo approximation. Although this probabilistic interpretation is valid for stationary processes, it is overly restrictive for the nonstationary case, where spectral densities are generally not probability measures. We propose regular Fourier features for harmonizable processes to avoid this limitation. Our method discretizes the spectral representation directly, preserving the correlation structure among spectral weights without requiring probability assumptions. Under a finite-spectral-support assumption, this yields an efficient low-rank approximation that is consistent and positive semi-definite by construction. When the spectral density is unknown, the framework extends naturally to kernel learning from data. We demonstrate the method on locally stationary and harmonizable mixture kernels, the latter with a complex-valued spectral density, and apply the kernel-learning extension to real and synthetic data.

title: How Does the ReLU Activation Affect the Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent on High-dimensional Neural Network Regression?
summary: Overparameterized ML models, including neural networks, typically induce underdetermined training objectives with multiple global minima. The implicit bias refers to the limiting global minimum that is attained by a common optimization algorithm, such as gradient descent (GD). In this paper, we characterize the implicit bias of GD for training a shallow ReLU model with the squared loss on high-dimensional random features. Prior work (Vardi and Shamir, 2021) showed that the implicit bias does not exist in the worst-case, or corresponds exactly to the minimum-$\ell_2$-norm interpolating solution under exactly orthogonal data (Boursier et al., 2022). Our work interpolates between these two extremes and shows that, for sufficiently high-dimensional random data, the implicit bias approximates the minimum-$\ell_2$-norm solution with high probability with a gap on the order $Θ(\sqrt{n/||λ||_1})$, where $n$ is the number of training examples and $λ$ denotes the spectrum of the data covariance matrix. Our results are obtained through a novel primal-dual analysis that carefully tracks the evolution of predictions, data-span coefficients, as well as their interactions, and show that the ReLU activation pattern quickly stabilizes with high probability over random data.

AI.title_translation: ReLU激活函数如何影响高维神经网络回归中梯度下降的隐式偏差？
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在高维随机数据下，ReLU神经网络的梯度下降训练倾向于收敛到近似最小L2范数解，并量化了其偏差程度。
AI.motivation: 旨在探讨过参数化神经网络中，梯度下降算法在处理高维回归问题时，ReLU激活函数如何影响其收敛到的隐式偏差（即特定全局极小值）。
AI.method: 采用新颖的原始-对偶分析方法，通过追踪预测值、数据跨度系数及其相互作用的演化，并证明了ReLU激活模式在随机数据下能以高概率快速稳定。
AI.result: 证明了在充分高维的随机数据下，隐式偏差以高概率近似于最小L2范数解，且误差项为Θ(sqrt(n/||λ||_1))，其中n为样本数，λ为数据协方差矩阵的谱。
AI.conclusion: 对于高维随机数据，ReLU神经网络在梯度下降训练下的隐式偏差以高概率近似于最小L2范数解，其偏差大小取决于数据维度、样本数及数据协方差矩阵的谱。
AI.translation: 过参数化的机器学习模型（包括神经网络）通常会导致具有多个全局极小值的欠定训练目标。隐式偏差是指常用优化算法（如梯度下降，GD）所达到的极限全局极小值。在本文中，我们刻画了GD在处理高维随机特征上利用平方损失训练浅层ReLU模型的隐式偏差。先前的研究（Vardi和Shamir，2021）表明，隐式偏差在最坏情况下不存在，或者在完全正交数据下恰好对应于最小L2范数插值解（Boursier等人，2022）。我们的工作在这两个极端之间进行了插值，并表明对于充分高维的随机数据，隐式偏差以高概率近似于最小L2范数解，其差距阶数为Θ(sqrt(n/||λ||_1))，其中n是训练样本数，λ表示数据协方差矩阵的谱。我们的结果通过一种新颖的原始-对偶分析获得，该分析仔细追踪了预测值、数据跨度系数及其相互作用的演化，并表明ReLU激活模式在随机数据上以高概率迅速稳定。
AI.summary: 本文研究了高维随机特征下ReLU神经网络的隐式偏差问题。作者通过原始-对偶分析表明，梯度下降训练出的解在充分高维的数据下，能以高概率逼近最小L2范数解，并给出了具体的误差界限，填补了现有理论在最坏情况与正交数据假设之间的空白。
AI.keywords: ReLU激活函数, 隐式偏差, 梯度下降, 高维回归, 随机特征
AI.comments: 该论文通过新颖的原始-对偶分析，成功连接了现有文献在最坏情况和正交数据假设下的两种极端结论，为理解高维神经网络中ReLU激活函数的隐式偏差提供了更细致的理论框架。其局限性在于主要针对随机特征模型，对于更复杂的深度网络架构的普适性仍有待进一步验证。

title: PolyBench: A Benchmark for Compositional Reasoning in Polyphonic Audio
summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) are increasingly capable of reasoning over audio, yet existing benchmarks offer limited coverage of reasoning in polyphonic audio, where multiple sound events co-occur and induce compositional structure. To address this gap, we introduce PolyBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate compositional reasoning in polyphonic audio, comprising five evaluation subsets that cover counting, classification, detection, concurrency, and duration estimation, all of which require reasoning over multiple concurrent events and their relations. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art LALMs reveals consistent performance degradation in polyphonic settings, indicating a fundamental bottleneck in current LALMs.

AI.title_translation: PolyBench：多声部音频中组合推理的基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了PolyBench基准，用于评估音频模型在多声部、复杂组合音频事件中的推理能力，并发现当前主流大模型在此领域表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频基准测试在多声部音频（即多个声音事件同时发生并具有组合结构）的推理覆盖率上存在不足，限制了大型音频语言模型在该复杂场景下的发展。
AI.method: 构建了包含计数、分类、检测、并发性和时长估计五个子集的PolyBench基准，用于评估模型对多重并发音频事件及其关系的组合推理能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有最先进的LALMs在多声部音频设置中表现出持续的性能下降，证明了模型处理组合音频结构的根本性瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前先进的LALMs在多声部音频处理上存在显著性能瓶颈，亟需专门针对组合推理能力进行模型优化。
AI.translation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在音频推理方面能力日益增强，但现有的基准测试对于多声部音频（多个声音事件同时发生并具有组合结构）中推理能力的覆盖有限。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了PolyBench，这是一个旨在评估多声部音频中组合推理能力的基准，包含五个评估子集，涵盖计数、分类、检测、并发性和时长估计，所有这些都需要对多个并发事件及其关系进行推理。我们对最先进的LALMs进行的评估显示，它们在多声部设置中性能持续下降，表明当前LALMs存在根本性的瓶颈。
AI.summary: PolyBench是一个专门用于评估多声部音频中组合推理能力的基准测试。它涵盖了计数、分类、检测、并发和时长估计五个维度，揭示了当前音频语言模型在处理复杂并发音频事件时的能力缺口。
AI.keywords: 多声部音频, 组合推理, 音频语言模型, 基准测试, 场景理解
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建PolyBench基准测试，揭示了当前大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在处理复杂多声部音频时的局限性。其创新点在于将“组合推理”引入音频领域，对于提升模型在复杂真实场景下的理解能力具有重要意义。局限性在于目前仅提出了基准，尚未针对性地提出解决该瓶颈的架构改进。

title: Continual Adaptation for Pacific Indigenous Speech Recognition
summary: Speech foundation models struggle with low-resource Pacific Indigenous languages because of severe data scarcity. Furthermore, full fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting. To address this gap, we present an empirical study adapting models to real-world Pacific datasets. We investigate the impact of data volume, adaptation strategies, and representational drift on speech foundation models for various Pacific languages. Additionally, we analyze a continual learning framework for sequential language acquisition. Empirical results across three distinct Pacific Indigenous languages demonstrate that adapting to these linguistically distant languages induces severe internal representational drift. Consequently, these models face a strict plasticity and stability dilemma. While LoRA adapts well initially, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting during sequential learning. Ultimately, this study highlights the urgent need for robust adaptation strategies tailored to underrepresented languages.

AI.title_translation: 太平洋原住民语音识别的持续适应研究
AI.tldr: 研究发现语音基础模型在适应太平洋原住民语言时存在严重的表示漂移和灾难性遗忘问题，现有微调技术难以平衡模型的可塑性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 语音基础模型在太平洋原住民语言等低资源语言上表现不佳，且全参数微调会导致灾难性遗忘，因此亟需探索有效的模型适应与持续学习方法。
AI.method: 通过实证研究评估了不同数据量、适应策略（特别是LoRA）以及持续学习框架在三种太平洋原住民语言上的表现，并分析了模型内部的表示漂移现象。
AI.result: 实验表明，适应语言距离较远的语言会导致严重的内部表示漂移；LoRA虽然在初始阶段表现良好，但在序列学习任务中仍会遭受灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 针对太平洋原住民语言的语音识别适应，现有的微调策略在处理语言差异和持续学习时面临严重的表示漂移与灾难性遗忘挑战，亟需开发更鲁棒的适应策略。
AI.translation: 语音基础模型由于严重的数据稀缺，难以处理低资源太平洋原住民语言。此外，全参数微调存在灾难性遗忘的风险。为了解决这一差距，我们对将模型适应到现实世界太平洋数据集进行了实证研究。我们调查了数据量、适应策略以及表示漂移对针对各种太平洋语言的语音基础模型的影响。此外，我们还分析了一个用于序列语言习得的持续学习框架。在三种不同的太平洋原住民语言上的实验结果表明，适应这些语言距离较远的语言会导致严重的内部表示漂移。因此，这些模型面临着严格的可塑性和稳定性困境。虽然LoRA在初始阶段适应良好，但在序列学习过程中会遭受灾难性遗忘。最终，这项研究强调了针对代表性不足语言量身定制鲁棒适应策略的迫切需求。
AI.summary: 本文针对太平洋原住民语言的语音识别难题，研究了语音基础模型的适应策略。通过实证分析发现，模型在适应语言差异较大的任务时会发生显著的表示漂移，并面临持续学习中的灾难性遗忘挑战，强调了开发专用鲁棒适应策略的必要性。
AI.keywords: 语音基础模型, 太平洋原住民语言, 持续学习, 表示漂移, 低资源语音识别
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了在低资源语言适应中，预训练模型面临的“可塑性与稳定性”权衡问题，特别是在处理语言距离较远的任务时，表示漂移是一个关键挑战。虽然LoRA等参数高效微调方法表现良好，但仍需解决持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，这为未来的低资源语音研究指明了方向。

title: Something from Nothing: Data Augmentation for Robust Severity Level Estimation of Dysarthric Speech
comments: Accepted to Interspeech 2026 Long Paper Track
summary: Dysarthric speech quality assessment (DSQA) is critical for clinical diagnostics and inclusive speech technologies. However, subjective evaluation is costly and difficult to scale, and the scarcity of labeled data limits robust objective modeling. To address this, we propose a three-stage framework that leverages unlabeled dysarthric speech and large-scale typical speech datasets to scale training. A teacher model first generates pseudo-labels for unlabeled samples, followed by weakly supervised pretraining using a label-aware contrastive learning strategy that exposes the model to diverse speakers and acoustic conditions. The pretrained model is then fine-tuned for the downstream DSQA task. Experiments on five unseen datasets spanning multiple etiologies and languages demonstrate the robustness of our approach. Our Whisper-based baseline significantly outperforms SOTA DSQA predictors such as SpICE, and the full framework achieves an average SRCC of 0.761 across unseen test datasets.
comment: Accepted to Interspeech 2026 Long Paper Track

AI.title_translation: 无中生有：用于构音障碍语音严重程度鲁棒评估的数据增强方法
AI.tldr: 通过利用未标注数据和大规模普通语音进行预训练与数据增强，显著提升了构音障碍语音严重程度评估模型的性能与跨场景鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍语音质量评估（DSQA）中，主观评估成本高且难以扩展，而带标注的客观训练数据稀缺，限制了建模的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出一个三阶段框架：1. 使用教师模型为未标注的构音障碍语音生成伪标签；2. 采用标签感知的对比学习策略进行弱监督预训练；3. 在下游任务中进行微调。该方法基于Whisper模型构建。
AI.result: 在五个未见过的跨病因和跨语言数据集上，基于Whisper的基线模型显著优于SpICE等现有SOTA方法；完整框架在未见测试集上实现了0.761的平均SRCC。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的基于Whisper的三阶段数据增强框架，通过伪标签生成和标签感知对比学习，在构音障碍语音严重程度评估任务中取得了显著优于现有SOTA方法的效果，具备极强的跨数据集鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 构音障碍语音质量评估（DSQA）对于临床诊断和包容性语音技术至关重要。然而，主观评估成本高昂且难以扩展，标注数据的稀缺性也限制了鲁棒客观模型的建立。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个三阶段框架，利用未标注的构音障碍语音和大规模普通语音数据集来扩展训练。教师模型首先为未标注样本生成伪标签，随后采用标签感知的对比学习策略进行弱监督预训练，使模型接触到更多样的说话人和声学条件。最后，将预训练模型在下游DSQA任务上进行微调。在五个跨越多种病因和语言的未见数据集上的实验证明了我们方法的鲁棒性。我们基于Whisper的基线模型明显优于SpICE等现有的SOTA DSQA预测器，且整个框架在未见的测试数据集上实现了0.761的平均SRCC。
AI.summary: 本文针对构音障碍语音评估中数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种基于Whisper的三阶段框架。该方法利用大规模普通语音和未标注构音障碍语音，通过伪标签生成与标签感知对比学习进行预训练，显著提升了模型在不同病因及语言环境下的评估鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 构音障碍语音评估, 数据增强, 对比学习, 半监督学习, 语音鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的半监督学习和对比学习策略，有效缓解了构音障碍语音数据稀缺的问题。其核心贡献在于证明了利用大规模普通语音和未标注构音障碍语音进行预训练，能显著提升模型在多病因和跨语言场景下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: Quantum Pattern Matching in Generalised Degenerate Strings
summary: A degenerate string is a sequence of sets of characters. A generalized degenerate (GD) string extends this notion to the sequence of sets of strings, where strings of the same set are of equal length. Finding an exact match for a pattern string inside a GD string can be done in $O(mn+N)$ time (Ascone et al., WABI 2024), where $m$ is the pattern length, $n$ is the number of strings and $N$ the total length of strings constituting the GD string. This is the best classical algorithm achieved so far, and no matching lower bound, neither unconditional nor conditional, has been shown. We make progress on this problem proposing a quantum algorithm that achieves running time $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{mnN})$, thus beating the current best classical solution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first quantum algorithm proposed in the context of GD strings. We present our results starting from the framework of classical parallel computing, which we believe makes them intuitive to understand and possibly easy to generalise to other similar structures.

title: Frequency-Division Multiplexed CV-QKD System
summary: We propose a frequency-division multiplexed (FDM) continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) system with enhanced spectral efficiency through optimized channel spacing of low-symbol-rate signals. A four-channel 10-Mbaud FDM-CV-QKD system was experimentally demonstrated using Gaussian modulation, a transmitted local oscillator, and homodyne detection. Despite the inter-channel interference, under a finite-size scenario (m=1.25x10^6), the system achieved a 3.6-fold back-to-back secret key rate gain and outperformed the single-channel frequency-upconverted signal up to 26.8 km.

title: IPSL-AID: Generative Diffusion Models for Climate Downscaling from Global to Regional Scales
comments: 17 pages, 12 figures, submitted to Climate Informatique 2026, to appear in Environmental Data Science
summary: Effective adaptation and mitigation strategies for climate change require high-resolution projections to inform strategic decision-making. Conventional global climate models, which typically operate at resolutions of 150 to 200 kilometers, lack the capacity to represent essential regional processes. IPSL-AID is a global to regional downscaling tool based on a denoising diffusion probabilistic model designed to address this limitation. Trained on ERA5 reanalysis data, it generates 0.25 degree resolution fields for temperature, wind, and precipitation using coarse inputs and their spatiotemporal context. It also models probability distributions of fine-scale features to produce plausible scenarios for uncertainty quantification. The model accurately reconstructs statistical distributions, including extreme events, power spectra, and spatial structures. This work highlights the potential of generative diffusion models for efficient climate downscaling with uncertainty

AI.title_translation: IPSL-AID：用于从全球到区域尺度气候降尺度的生成式扩散模型
AI.tldr: 利用生成式扩散模型将低分辨率全球气候数据转化为高分辨率区域数据，并能有效量化极端气候事件的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 传统全球气候模型分辨率较低（150-200公里），无法满足区域气候适应和减缓策略对高分辨率数据的需求。
AI.method: 基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），利用ERA5再分析数据进行训练，通过粗分辨率输入及空时上下文信息，生成0.25度分辨率的温度、风速和降水场，并建模细尺度特征的概率分布。
AI.result: 模型成功实现了从全球尺度到区域尺度的降尺度，能够准确重构气候变量的统计分布、极端事件、功率谱及空间结构，并有效量化不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式扩散模型是一种高效的气候降尺度工具，能够准确重构气候变量的统计分布、极端事件及空间结构，为气候变化适应策略提供高分辨率数据支持。
AI.translation: 有效的气候变化适应和减缓策略需要高分辨率的投影来为战略决策提供信息。传统的全球气候模型通常在150到200公里的分辨率下运行，缺乏表示基本区域过程的能力。IPSL-AID是一个基于去噪扩散概率模型的全球到区域降尺度工具，旨在解决这一局限性。它在ERA5再分析数据上进行训练，利用粗输入及其时空上下文生成温度、风和降水的0.25度分辨率场。它还对细尺度特征的概率分布进行建模，以产生用于不确定性量化的合理情景。该模型准确地重建了统计分布，包括极端事件、功率谱和空间结构。这项工作突出了生成式扩散模型在具有不确定性的高效气候降尺度方面的潜力。
AI.summary: IPSL-AID是一个基于去噪扩散概率模型的气候降尺度工具。它通过训练ERA5数据，将粗分辨率的全球气候模型输入转化为0.25度的高分辨率区域气候数据（温度、风速、降水），在提供高分辨率投影的同时，通过建模细尺度特征概率分布实现了有效的不确定性量化。
AI.keywords: 气候降尺度, 扩散模型, 高分辨率投影, 不确定性量化, 气象学
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将扩散模型引入气候降尺度领域，解决了传统动力降尺度计算量大和统计降尺度难以捕捉复杂空间结构的问题。其能够生成概率分布的特性对于量化气候极端事件的不确定性具有重要的科学和决策价值。

title: From Paper to Program: Externalizing and Diagnosing Knowledge Bottlenecks in AI-Assisted Quantum Many-Body Code Generation
summary: Large language models can write scientific code, but direct paper-to-program translation remains fragile when correctness depends on tacit conventions rather than explicit equations. We frame this as a \textbf{knowledge-externalization} problem: index choices, gauges, fermionic signs, contraction order, validation gates, and scaling constraints must be made explicit before code generation. We evaluate a multi-stage, human-in-the-loop workflow on two quantum many-body tasks. DMRG from Schollwock's pedagogical review serves as calibration: specification-guided implementations pass in all 16 model pairings, compared with 6/13 direct attempts, and a prose-specification ablation shows that externalized content, not \LaTeX{} form, is the active ingredient. Pfaffian conversion of HFB states to MPS from the five-page Letter by Jin et al. serves as the stress test: no public implementation is available, and success depends on tacit sign, gauge, ordering, and scalability conventions. Here the workflow yields 11/26 audited passes, while direct prompting yields none. Cross-specification transfer is asymmetric: non-GPT specifications implemented by GPT~5.5 pass 4/4, whereas GPT~5.5 specifications implemented by weaker models fail 4/4. The contrast supports a two-bottleneck picture. Externalization resolves the first bottleneck -- paper-to-code ambiguity -- well enough to make DMRG reproducible and Pfaffian-MPS auditable. The remaining failures expose a second bottleneck in implementation-model capability. Iterative meta-specification moves this boundary but does not eliminate it. The resulting \emph{Paper-to-Program Many-Body} skill is both a reusable implementation protocol and a diagnostic instrument for AI-assisted many-body programming.

AI.title_translation: 从论文到程序：AI辅助量子多体代码生成中知识瓶颈的外化与诊断
AI.tldr: 通过将物理论文中的隐性惯例转化为显式元规范，该研究有效解决了AI编写科学代码时的歧义问题，并为诊断AI模型的能力瓶颈提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 直接将科学论文转化为代码往往因依赖隐性惯例而非显式方程而失败，旨在解决这一知识瓶颈问题，实现量子多体物理代码的准确生成。
AI.method: 提出了一种“多阶段、人机协同”的工作流，通过将物理论文中的隐性惯例（如索引、规范、费米子符号等）显式化为“元规范”，引导大语言模型进行代码生成，并对比了直接提示与规范引导下的生成效果。
AI.result: 在DMRG任务中，规范引导的实现成功率显著高于直接提示（16/16 vs 6/13）；在更复杂的Pfaffian-MPS转换任务中，该工作流实现了11/26的审计通过率，而直接提示则完全失败。实验证明了外化内容是提升成功率的关键，而非LaTeX格式。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过知识外化可以有效解决物理论文到代码转换中的歧义性问题，但代码生成的最终成功仍受限于AI模型本身的实现能力。该工作为复杂科学领域的AI辅助编程提供了一种可复用的协议和诊断工具。
AI.translation: 大语言模型能够编写科学代码，但当代码的正确性依赖于隐性惯例而非显式方程时，直接将论文转化为程序的过程仍然非常脆弱。我们将此定义为“知识外化”问题：在代码生成之前，必须明确索引选择、规范、费米子符号、收缩顺序、验证门和缩放约束。我们在两个量子多体任务上评估了一个多阶段、人机协同的工作流。以Schollwock的教学综述为基础的DMRG作为校准：规范引导的实现可以在所有16个模型配对中通过，而直接尝试为6/13，且消融实验表明外化内容而非LaTeX格式是成功的关键因素。以Jin等人五页快报中的HFB态到MPS的Pfaffian转换为压力测试：目前尚无公开实现，成功取决于隐性的符号、规范、排序和可扩展性约定。在此任务中，该工作流产生了11/26的审计通过率，而直接提示则无一成功。跨规范迁移是不对称的：由非GPT规范引导并由GPT 5.5实现的通过率为4/4，而由GPT 5.5规范引导并由较弱模型实现的则全部失败。这种对比支持了“双重瓶颈”的观点。外化解决了第一个瓶颈——论文到代码的歧义——使DMRG具有可复现性，Pfaffian-MPS具有可审计性。剩余的失败暴露了实现模型能力方面的第二个瓶颈。迭代元规范移动了这一边界，但并未消除它。由此产生的“论文到程序多体”技能既是一种可重用的实现协议，也是AI辅助多体编程的诊断仪器。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在量子多体物理代码生成中因缺乏隐性惯例知识而导致的脆弱性，提出了一种知识外化工作流。通过将论文中的隐性约定显式化为元规范，该方法在DMRG和Pfaffian-MPS任务中显著提升了代码生成的准确性和可审计性，并揭示了代码生成中存在论文-代码歧义和模型能力实现两个主要瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 量子多体物理, 代码生成, 知识外化, 大语言模型, 科学计算
AI.comments: 该研究深刻地揭示了LLM在科学计算代码生成中的核心瓶颈，即“隐性知识”的缺失。通过将“知识外化”作为一种系统性的方法论，作者不仅提高了代码生成的准确性，还为评估AI模型的科学推理能力提供了一个极佳的诊断框架。创新之处在于将复杂的物理学惯例转化为可操作的元规范（meta-specification）。

title: Invariant Guided PINN for Fluid Flow Computation
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often become difficult to optimize for incompressible flow problems with large spatial domains, multiscale stresses, or long-time invariant dynamics. We propose an invariant-guided PINN (IG-PINN) framework that uses partitioned training as a conservative preconditioning stage rather than as the final piecewise representation. A globally defined architecture is trained successively on spatial subdomains or temporal slabs; selected field traces, structural information, and conservative diagnostics are then transferred to a final global correction, yielding a single neural field on the full spatial or space-time domain. The framework is tested on two incompressible flow problems: steady Oldroyd--B flow past a confined cylinder and a rotational Newtonian flow with helicity diagnostics. In the Oldroyd--B case, IG-PINN transfers velocity, polymeric stress, and mass-flux information while avoiding pressure traces at artificial interfaces. In the helicity case, endpoint velocity is transferred through a hard temporal constraint and kinetic energy is controlled during slab training and residual global correction. The experiments demonstrate improved optimization robustness, reduced conservation errors for the cylinder wake, and controlled energy and helicity diagnostics for the transient rotational flow.

AI.title_translation: 用于流体流动计算的不变性引导物理信息神经网络 (IG-PINN)
AI.tldr: IG-PINN通过分区训练作为预处理，提升了PINN在处理复杂不可压缩流问题时的优化鲁棒性和物理守恒性。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在处理具有大空间域、多尺度应力或长时间不变动力学的不可压缩流问题时，面临优化困难，难以获得满意的解。
AI.method: 提出了一种不变性引导的PINN (IG-PINN) 框架。该方法首先采用分区训练（空间子域或时间分片）作为保守预处理阶段，将场迹、结构信息和守恒诊断数据传递到最终的全局修正阶段，从而训练出一个统一的全局神经网络场。
AI.result: 在Oldroyd-B流和旋转牛顿流测试中，IG-PINN表现出了更强的优化鲁棒性，有效降低了圆柱绕流问题的守恒误差，并能精确控制瞬态旋转流中的能量和螺旋度诊断。
AI.conclusion: IG-PINN框架通过分区训练和不变性传递，成功克服了传统PINN在处理大型空间域和复杂流体动力学时的优化瓶颈，为求解复杂不可压缩流问题提供了一种高效且高精度的方案。
AI.translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在处理具有大空间域、多尺度应力或长时间不变动力学的不可压缩流问题时，往往难以优化。我们提出了一种不变性引导的PINN（IG-PINN）框架，该框架使用分区训练作为一种保守的预处理阶段，而不是作为最终的分段表示。一个全局定义的架构在空间子域或时间分片上依次进行训练；选定的场迹、结构信息和保守诊断数据随后被传递到最终的全局修正中，从而在整个空间或时空域上产生单一的神经场。该框架在两个不可压缩流问题上进行了测试：受限圆柱绕流的稳态Oldroyd-B流和具有螺旋度诊断的旋转牛顿流。在Oldroyd-B案例中，IG-PINN传递了速度、聚合物应力和质量通量信息，同时避免了人工界面处的压力迹。在螺旋度案例中，端点速度通过硬时间约束进行传递，动能则在分片训练和残差全局修正期间受到控制。实验表明，该方法提高了优化鲁棒性，减少了圆柱尾流的守恒误差，并实现了对瞬态旋转流的能量和螺旋度诊断的控制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为IG-PINN的框架，旨在解决PINN在处理复杂不可压缩流问题时的优化挑战。通过引入基于分区训练的预处理阶段，将关键物理信息（如速度、应力和守恒量）传递至全局修正阶段，该方法有效地提升了求解大型空间域和长时间动力学问题的能力与精度。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 不可压缩流, 分区训练, 不变性引导, 计算流体力学
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“不变性引导”和“分区训练”策略，巧妙地解决了PINN在处理复杂流体问题（如不可压缩流、多尺度应力、长时间动力学）时的优化难题。其创新之处在于将分区训练作为一种预处理手段，而非简单的分段拼接，从而在保持全局神经网络场的同时，显著提升了训练的鲁棒性和物理守恒性。

title: Unraveling the Mechanism of Drug Binding to SARS-CoV-2 RNA Pseudoknot with Thermodynamics-Driven Machine Learning
summary: The pseudoknot secondary structure in SARS-CoV-2 RNA is essential for regulating protein synthesis through $-$1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting ($-1$ PRF), a mechanism that allows the virus to generate both structural and non-structural proteins from overlapping reading frames. This pseudoknot exhibits both threaded and unthreaded long-lived topologies. The influence of ligand binding on its folding is a process critical for the development of $-$1 PRF small-molecule inhibitors. Understanding this process through unbiased molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can be facilitated by introducing collective variables (CVs) that capture the corresponding slowest dynamical modes. Here, we use spectral map (SM), a thermodynamics-driven machine learning technique, to learn such CVs directly from all-atom MD trajectories of the SARS-CoV-2 RNA pseudoknot in complex with the $-$1 PRF inhibitor merafloxacin and its two structural analogs in neutral and ionized forms. Free-energy landscapes (FELs) derived from the learned CVs indicate that ligand-induced destabilization is topology-selective. In the threaded pseudoknot, the inhibitors destabilize the S2 stem, while in the unthreaded pseudoknot, destabilization occurs in the S1 and S3 stems. Furthermore, the extent to which each ligand reshapes the FEL matches experimentally reported antiviral potency, whereas the protonation state qualitatively alters dynamics within the same RNA topology. Overall, our results show how pseudoknot topology, ligand type, and protonation state collectively influence the slow conformational dynamics of viral RNA and establish physiological protonation as a critical factor for modeling RNA-targeted drug action.

AI.title_translation: 利用热力学驱动的机器学习揭示药物与SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结的结合机制
AI.tldr: 该研究通过机器学习分析了药物与SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结的结合，发现配体诱导的失稳具有拓扑选择性，并强调了质子化状态对药物作用模拟的重要性。
AI.motivation: SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结对于-1程序化核糖体移码（-1 PRF）至关重要，理解配体结合如何影响其折叠过程，对于开发-1 PRF小分子抑制剂具有重要意义。
AI.method: 利用热力学驱动的机器学习技术——谱图法（Spectral Map, SM），从全原子分子动力学（MD）轨迹中学习集体变量（CVs），进而构建并分析自由能景观（FELs）。
AI.result: 发现配体诱导的失稳具有拓扑选择性：在螺旋伪结中，抑制剂使S2茎失稳；在非螺旋伪结中，失稳发生在S1和S3茎。计算出的自由能景观重塑程度与实验报告的抗病毒效力相吻合，且质子化状态显著改变了RNA的动力学行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，伪结拓扑结构、配体类型和质子化状态共同决定了病毒RNA的构象动力学。质子化状态是模拟RNA靶向药物作用的关键因素，且计算出的自由能景观重塑程度与实验测得的抗病毒效力高度一致。
AI.translation: SARS-CoV-2 RNA中的伪结二级结构对于通过-1程序化核糖体移码（-1 PRF）调节蛋白质合成至关重要，该机制使病毒能够从重叠的阅读框中产生结构和非结构蛋白。该伪结表现出螺旋和非螺旋的长寿命拓扑结构。配体结合对其折叠的影响是开发-1 PRF小分子抑制剂的关键过程。通过引入能够捕获相应最慢动力学模式的集体变量（CVs），可以促进通过无偏分子动力学（MD）模拟来理解这一过程。在这里，我们使用谱图法（SM），一种热力学驱动的机器学习技术，直接从SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结与-1 PRF抑制剂merafloxacin及其两种结构类似物（中性和离子化形式）复合物的全原子MD轨迹中学习此类CVs。由学习到的CVs导出的自由能景观（FELs）表明，配体诱导的失稳具有拓扑选择性。在螺旋伪结中，抑制剂使S2茎失稳，而在非螺旋伪结中，失稳发生在S1和S3茎。此外，每种配体重塑FEL的程度与实验报告的抗病毒效力相匹配，而质子化状态在相同的RNA拓扑结构内定性地改变了动力学。总的来说，我们的结果展示了伪结拓扑结构、配体类型和质子化状态如何共同影响病毒RNA的慢构象动力学，并将生理质子化确立为模拟RNA靶向药物作用的关键因素。
AI.summary: 本文利用热力学驱动的机器学习方法（谱图法）分析了SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结与抑制剂merafloxacin及其类似物的结合机制。研究揭示了配体结合对RNA拓扑结构失稳的影响具有选择性，并证实了质子化状态和伪结拓扑结构是影响RNA构象动力学的关键参数，为抗病毒药物开发提供了新视角。
AI.keywords: SARS-CoV-2, RNA伪结, 机器学习, 分子动力学模拟, 药物筛选
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将热力学驱动的机器学习技术（谱图法，SM）应用于RNA动力学分析，不仅揭示了药物与SARS-CoV-2 RNA伪结结合的复杂机制，还强调了质子化状态在药物设计中的重要性。这一发现为开发针对RNA的抗病毒药物提供了重要的理论指导。

title: Controllable Quantum Memory Capacity in Quantum Reservoir Networks with Tunable partial-SWAPs
summary: In the field of quantum reservoir computing (QRC), many different computational models and architectures have been proposed. From these models, we identify feedback-based models -- which use a feedback mechanism to re-embed classical measurements from the QRC -- and recurrent models -- which use a multi-register approach with memory and readout qubits -- as the two major competing architectures that have been discussed and validated on hardware. In this paper, we advance upon the recurrent architectures, which employ a two register approach to endow the QRC with a fading memory. While these approaches have been validated on hardware and have demonstrated great real-world performance on noisy-intermediate-scale-quantum (NISQ) quantum processing units (QPUs), the exact mechanism through which the memory capacity arises is not completely understood or fully controllable. With this, we augment the recurrent approaches and present a hardware-realizable mechanism, which we call a tunable partial-SWAP, that allows for the direct control of the rate of memory dissipation from a QRN implemented on a gate-based QPU. The theory behind this mechanism is discussed in terms of a controlled amplitude-damping channel and validation experiments using a randomized short-term memory capacity (STMC) recall benchmark and the NARMA-5 dataset are conducted using simulation and IBM QPUs, respectively.

title: Everywhere Valid Bounds on False Discovery Proportions in Conformal Inference
summary: Modern applications of conformal inference to multiple testing problems, such as outlier detection and candidate selection, often involve selecting test samples whose conformal p-values fall below a threshold. The quality of such methods is often measured by the false discovery proportion (FDP), defined as the fraction of incorrect selections. Existing approaches typically control the expected value of the FDP, using methods such as the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. This approach fails to provide high-probability bounds on the realized false discovery proportion and invalidates statistical guarantees if the rejection threshold is selected after inspecting the data. This paper establishes finite-sample, distribution-free upper bounds on the FDP that hold simultaneously over all possible rejection thresholds, enabling arbitrary post hoc selection of the threshold. Simultaneous validity is achieved by constructing a high-probability envelope for the empirical distribution function of null conformal p-values by sampling from their joint distribution. Furthermore, our framework allows practitioners to modulate the envelope's shape, thereby producing tight bounds in rejection regions of primary interest. We use this flexible approach to derive simultaneous FDP upper bounds for both outlier detection and conformal selection. We demonstrate through synthetic and real-data experiments that the resulting bounds are both valid and substantially less conservative than those derived from existing approaches.

title: A sharp interaction-degree threshold for simulating QAOA
summary: We identify a sharp interaction-degree threshold for the classical simulation of QAOA with $2$-local cost functions. At degree~$3$, classical sampling from depth-$1$ QAOA, even within multiplicative error $2^{n^{s}}$ for any fixed $s < 1$, would collapse the polynomial hierarchy to its third level. At degree $2$, exact classical sampling from depth-$p$ QAOA on $n$ qubits runs in time $n^{O(1)}$ whenever $p = O(\log n)$. The hard degree-$3$ instances have trivially optimizable cost functions, so sampling hardness does not by itself imply a quantum optimization advantage.

AI.title_translation: QAOA模拟的尖锐相互作用度数阈值
AI.tldr: QAOA算法的模拟难度存在一个度数阈值：度数为2时可经典高效模拟，度数为3时则变得极难。

AI.method: 通过复杂度理论分析，研究了不同相互作用度数（2和3）下QAOA模拟的计算难度，对比了精确采样与乘性误差采样在不同深度下的复杂度。
AI.result: 证明了度数为3时，QAOA的采样在多项式时间内是困难的（假设多项式层级不坍缩）；而度数为2时，对于$p=O(\log n)$的深度，QAOA可以在多项式时间内进行精确经典采样。
AI.conclusion: QAOA在度数为2时是经典可模拟的，但当度数增加到3时，在特定误差范围内模拟该算法会引起多项式层级的坍缩，表明了度数是决定QAOA模拟难度的关键阈值。
AI.translation: 我们确定了具有2-局部代价函数的QAOA经典模拟的尖锐相互作用度数阈值。在度数为3时，对深度为1的QAOA进行经典采样（即使是在任何固定s < 1的乘性误差2^{n^{s}}范围内），都会导致多项式层级坍缩到其第三层。在度数为2时，当p = O(log n)时，对n个量子比特的深度为p的QAOA进行精确经典采样可以在n^{O(1)}时间内完成。度数为3的困难实例具有易于优化的代价函数，因此采样难度本身并不意味着量子优化优势。
AI.summary: 本文研究了QAOA经典模拟的相互作用度数阈值。研究发现，当相互作用度数为3时，模拟QAOA在计算上是困难的；而当度数为2时，QAOA在特定深度下是经典可模拟的。此外，度数为3的困难实例并不直接代表量子优化优势。
AI.keywords: QAOA, 经典模拟, 相互作用度数, 多项式层级, 量子计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了QAOA模拟难度与相互作用度数之间的本质联系。其创新之处在于证明了度数从2到3的跃迁会导致模拟难度的剧烈变化，这对于理解量子计算的优势边界具有重要理论意义。限制在于该结论主要针对特定的QAOA设置，且度数3的硬性并不直接等同于量子优化优势。

title: Data-driven sparse identification of governing PDEs via knockoff filters and multi-criteria trade-offs
summary: We propose KO-PDE-IDENT, a data-driven framework for identifying parsimonious partial differential equations (PDEs) with false discovery rate (FDR) control. PDE discovery from noisy observations is often hindered by extreme multicollinearity among candidate terms, which causes typical sparse-regression methods to select spurious terms. To address this problem, KO-PDE-IDENT initially mines a support set of potential candidate terms via model-X knockoff filters with finite-sample FDR control, then refines and ranks the surviving PDE alternatives. The framework integrates three components. First, knockoff feature statistics are constructed by coupling $\ell_{0}$-constrained adaptive best-subset selection with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), yielding an effective and computationally efficient difference statistic. Second, a recursive feature elimination (RFE) procedure removes terms whose marginal contributions are dispensable and assesses statistical necessity through knockoff-perturbed hypothesis testing. Third, the final model selection is formulated as a multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) problem, where the optimal governing equation is the alternative that best balances a wide range of criteria such as predictive accuracy, model complexity and coefficient uncertainty. We evaluate KO-PDE-IDENT on five canonical PDEs under severe noise corruption. Empirical results show that our framework can exactly recover the true PDE structure, eliminating false discoveries while retaining all true underlying terms, with low coefficient estimation error.

AI.title_translation: 基于 Knockoff 滤波器和多准则权衡的数据驱动稀疏偏微分方程识别
AI.tldr: KO-PDE-IDENT 是一种通过 FDR 控制和多准则决策从噪声数据中稳健识别偏微分方程的新框架，能有效避免虚假项选择。
AI.motivation: 从噪声观测数据中发现偏微分方程时，候选项之间存在极端的共线性，导致现有的稀疏回归方法容易选择虚假项，缺乏统计意义上的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了 KO-PDE-IDENT 框架，包含三个核心步骤：1. 利用基于 L0 约束的最佳子集选择和 SHAP 值构建 knockoff 特征统计量；2. 通过递归特征消除（RFE）和 knockoff 扰动假设检验移除多余项；3. 将最终模型选择转化为多准则决策问题（MCDM），平衡预测精度、模型复杂度和系数不确定性。
AI.result: 在五个经典 PDE 案例的测试中，该框架在严重噪声干扰下能够准确恢复真实的方程结构，消除了错误发现，同时保留了所有真实项，并实现了较低的系数估计误差。
AI.conclusion: KO-PDE-IDENT 框架成功实现了在噪声环境下对偏微分方程结构的精确恢复，通过 FDR 控制有效消除了虚假项，证明了该方法在处理复杂物理系统建模中的优越性和可靠性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 KO-PDE-IDENT，这是一个用于识别具有错误发现率 (FDR) 控制的简约偏微分方程 (PDE) 的数据驱动框架。从噪声观测中发现 PDE 经常受到候选项之间极端多重共线性的阻碍，这导致典型的稀疏回归方法选择虚假项。为了解决这个问题，KO-PDE-IDENT 首先通过具有有限样本 FDR 控制的 model-X knockoff 滤波器挖掘潜在候选项的支持集，然后细化并排序幸存的 PDE 备选方案。该框架整合了三个组件。首先，通过将 $\ell_{0}$ 约束自适应最佳子集选择与 SHapley 加性解释 (SHAP) 相结合来构建 knockoff 特征统计量，从而产生有效且计算高效的差异统计量。其次，递归特征消除 (RFE) 程序移除边际贡献可有可无的项，并通过 knockoff 扰动假设检验评估统计必要性。第三，最终模型选择被制定为多准则决策 (MCDM) 问题，其中最优控制方程是在预测准确性、模型复杂度和系数不确定性等广泛标准之间取得最佳平衡的备选方案。我们在严重噪声干扰下的五个经典 PDE 上评估了 KO-PDE-IDENT。实证结果表明，我们的框架可以精确恢复真实的 PDE 结构，消除错误发现，同时保留所有真实的潜在项，并具有较低的系数估计误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 KO-PDE-IDENT 框架，旨在利用具有错误发现率（FDR）控制的 knockoff 滤波器，从噪声数据中稳健地识别偏微分方程。该方法通过结合 SHAP 值、递归特征消除和多准则决策，有效解决了候选项间的共线性问题，实现了对真实物理方程结构的精确恢复。
AI.keywords: 偏微分方程发现, 错误发现率控制, Knockoff 滤波器, 多准则决策, 稀疏回归
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将模型无关的 knockoff filter 统计框架引入到偏微分方程（PDE）发现领域，有效解决了噪声数据中极端多重共线性导致的虚假项选择问题。通过结合 FDR 控制、SHAP 值和多准则决策分析，该方法在鲁棒性和解释性之间取得了很好的平衡。

title: Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series Generation
summary: Schrödinger bridges for time series (SBTS) generate synthetic paths by projecting, in relative entropy, a Brownian reference onto the path laws that match the joint distribution of the data on the observation grid. The Brownian reference, however, fixes the quadratic variation of the generated paths, which is restrictive when stochastic volatility, correlated noise, or rank-deficient covariance structures must be reproduced. We introduce "Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series" (TR-SBTS), which keeps the entropy-projection backbone of SBTS but replaces the Brownian reference by a triangular, volatility-informed, intervalwise frozen reference on a state augmented with latent covariance descriptors. The construction remains a single entropy projection on the augmented state: the minimiser is the \(h\)-transform of the reference, and on each frozen interval the optimal drift has the logarithmic-gradient form \(b^\star(t,x)=A\,\nabla\log H(t,x)\), intrinsic to the active covariance directions when the frozen covariance \(A\) is degenerate. We prove stability of the frozen approximation and consistency of the associated regularised kernel estimators, describe a reference-aware Nadaraya--Watson implementation of the conditional next-increment law, and evaluate the construction on numerical experiments.

title: Latent-Conditioned Parameterized Quantum Circuits as Universal Approximators for Distributions over Quantum States
comments: 21 pages, 11 figures (fix the proof and update appendix for barren plateaus analysis)
summary: Many applications in quantum simulation, quantum chemistry, and quantum machine learning require not a single quantum state but an ensemble of states characterizing the heterogeneity of a target system. Preparing such ensembles state-by-state is prohibitive in both variational and fault-tolerant settings, thereby motivating a generative modeling approach. We introduce latent-conditioned parameterized quantum circuits (LPQCs), a hybrid quantum-classical framework in which classical neural networks map a latent variable sampled from a prior distribution to the parameters of a parameterized quantum circuit. We prove that LPQCs are universal approximators for probability measures over density operators in the 1-Wasserstein distance, extending classical universal approximation theorems to the quantum-distribution setting. We additionally introduce a multimodal latent prior and a mixture-of-experts circuit architecture, and show empirically that the latent-conditioned parameterization alleviates the barren plateau problem during optimization, a behavior for which we provide rigorous partial guarantees. Numerical experiments validate the framework on a synthetic multi-cluster ensemble of mixed quantum states and on a QM9-derived ensemble of 3-D molecular structures. In these tasks, LPQC outperforms recent quantum generative baselines and matches the generation quality of a classical neural-network baseline, while requiring an output dimension that grows only linearly with the number of qubits rather than exponentially. By leveraging classical expressivity in the latent space, LPQCs offer a tractable route to quantum generative modeling.

AI.title_translation: 作为量子态分布通用逼近器的潜变量条件参数化量子电路
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典生成模型 LPQC，通过利用经典潜空间来高效生成量子态集合，在理论上证明了其通用性，并实验证实了其在缓解优化瓶颈（贫瘠高原）方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在量子模拟、化学和机器学习中，针对异构系统需要生成量子态的集合（Ensemble），而逐个准备量子态的方法在变分和容错设置下成本过高，因此需要一种生成式建模方法。

AI.conclusion: LPQC 框架通过利用经典潜在空间的表达能力，为量子生成建模提供了一种高效、可扩展且在理论上可靠的解决方案，不仅能够有效逼近复杂的量子态分布，还能显著改善优化过程。
AI.translation: 许多量子模拟、量子化学和量子机器学习的应用不需要单一的量子态，而是需要表征目标系统异构性的量子态集合。在变分和容错设置下，逐个准备这些集合是极其困难的，这促使人们采取生成式建模的方法。我们引入了潜在条件参数化量子电路（LPQC），这是一种混合量子-经典框架，其中经典神经网络将从先验分布中采样的潜变量映射到参数化量子电路的参数中。我们证明了 LPQC 在 1-Wasserstein 距离下是密度算子概率测度的通用逼近器，将经典通用逼近定理扩展到了量子分布设置。此外，我们引入了多模态潜先验和专家混合电路架构，并从经验上证明了潜在条件参数化缓解了优化过程中的贫瘠高原问题，并为此提供了严格的部分保证。数值实验在合成的混合量子态多簇集合和衍生自 QM9 的 3D 分子结构集合上验证了该框架。在这些任务中，LPQC 的表现优于最近的量子生成基准，并与经典神经网络基准的生成质量相当，同时其输出维度仅随量子比特数量线性增长，而非指数级增长。通过利用经典空间中的表达能力，LPQC 为量子生成建模提供了一条可行的路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了潜在条件参数化量子电路（LPQC），一种通过经典神经网络调节量子电路参数的混合架构，用于高效生成量子态集合。该方法不仅在理论上证明了其通用逼近能力，还通过实验验证了其在缓解贫瘠高原问题及提升生成效率方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 潜在条件参数化量子电路, 量子生成模型, 通用逼近器, 贫瘠高原, 量子机器学习

title: Knockoffs-based False Discovery Rate Control and Simplification for Deep Neural Networks
summary: The deep neural network is a widely used framework in machine learning that has been widely applied in various fields. However, deep neural networks often involve a large number of parameters and inputs, many of which may be irrelevant to the goal or true output. These parameters and input variables not only increase computational complexity, but also contribute to additional computational cost. One solution to this problem is knockoff methods, which have proven successful in controlling false discovery rates in high-dimensional regression. Building on the knockoff methods and using the regularised neural network, this paper proposes three variable screening methods under the condition of controlling false discovery rates: one layer filter, multiple layers filter, and variable weight aggregation filter. In comparison with existing algorithms, we find that our algorithms show satisfactory performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于Knockoffs的深度神经网络错误发现率控制与简化方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出三种基于Knockoffs的变量筛选方法，旨在深度神经网络中实现有效的错误发现率控制，并降低计算复杂性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络参数和输入变量过多，导致计算复杂度和成本增加，且其中包含大量与目标无关的冗余信息，需要一种有效的方法进行变量筛选并控制错误发现率。
AI.method: 在正则化神经网络的基础上，提出了三种变量筛选方法：单层过滤器（one layer filter）、多层过滤器（multiple layers filter）以及变量权重聚合过滤器（variable weight aggregation filter）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与现有算法相比，所提出的三种方法在变量筛选和控制错误发现率方面表现出令人满意的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的三种基于Knockoffs的变量筛选方法在控制错误发现率的同时，能有效简化深度神经网络，在处理高维数据时展现出优于现有算法的性能。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络是一种在机器学习中被广泛应用的框架，并已在各个领域得到广泛应用。然而，深度神经网络通常涉及大量的参数和输入，其中许多可能与目标或真实输出无关。这些参数和输入变量不仅增加了计算复杂度，还带来了额外的计算成本。解决此问题的一种方案是Knockoff方法，该方法已在高维回归中证明了在控制错误发现率方面的成功。基于Knockoff方法并利用正则化神经网络，本文提出了三种在控制错误发现率条件下的变量筛选方法：单层过滤器、多层过滤器和变量权重聚合过滤器。与现有算法相比，我们发现我们的算法表现出令人满意的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络中存在的参数冗余问题，提出了一种基于Knockoffs方法的变量筛选框架。通过引入单层、多层及权重聚合三种过滤器，在有效控制错误发现率的前提下，实现了对神经网络输入变量的精简，提升了模型的运算效率。
AI.keywords: 深度神经网络, 错误发现率, Knockoffs方法, 变量筛选, 模型简化
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将统计学中的“Knockoffs”方法引入深度学习领域，旨在解决深度神经网络的特征冗余与模型复杂性问题。其创新点在于将严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制引入到变量筛选中，这在提升模型可解释性和效率方面具有重要意义，但在处理极其复杂的非线性关系时其效果仍有待更广泛的实证研究。

title: Graph Reinforcement Learning for Calibration-Aware Quantum Circuit Routing
summary: Quantum circuit routing is a key step in compiling programs for noisy intermediate-scale quantum processors. Routes that appear efficient by standard overhead metrics can still lose fidelity when they pass through poorly calibrated couplers. We study a calibration-aware graph reinforcement-learning router that uses same-day IBM Heron r2 calibration data to choose hardware-edge SWAPs. We train the policy with proximal policy optimization and evaluate it with exact simulated fidelity across nine Munich Quantum Toolkit (MQT) Bench circuits and three calibration snapshots. Across these evaluations, pooled mean exact fidelity is $0.727$, compared with $0.440$ for SABRE-best20 and $0.481$ for target-aware SABRE. We observed that fidelity gains came with higher routed two-qubit counts and were concentrated in 5 qubit and 8 qubit circuit families; under the fixed tree action graph, all 10 qubit families favored SABRE-best20. Overall, our results show that calibration-aware learned routing can improve fidelity beyond gate-count-driven compilation.

AI.title_translation: 面向校准感知的量子电路路由的图强化学习研究
AI.tldr: 通过引入实时校准数据，基于图强化学习的路由算法在小规模量子电路中实现了比传统编译方法更高的执行保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有的量子电路路由算法多基于门操作数量等标准指标，忽略了量子芯片中不同耦合器校准质量的差异，导致程序在实际硬件上执行时保真度损失严重。
AI.method: 提出一种基于图强化学习的路由算法，利用IBM Heron r2的实时校准数据作为输入，采用近端策略优化（PPO）算法进行训练，并对比了传统SABRE算法。
AI.result: 在9个MQT基准电路测试中，该方法的平均保真度达到0.727，显著优于SABRE-best20（0.440）和目标感知SABRE（0.481）。但在10量子比特规模的电路中，传统SABRE算法表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: 校准感知（Calibration-aware）的强化学习路由方案能有效提升量子电路的执行保真度，证明了考虑硬件物理特性的编译策略优于纯粹的门计数优化。
AI.translation: 量子电路路由是将程序编译到噪声中等规模量子处理器上的关键步骤。以标准开销指标衡量看似高效的路由，在经过校准较差的耦合器时仍会损失保真度。我们研究了一种校准感知的图强化学习路由器，利用当天的IBM Heron r2校准数据来选择硬件边缘的SWAP操作。我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练该策略，并在9个Munich Quantum Toolkit (MQT) 基准电路和3个校准快照上进行了精确模拟保真度评估。在这些评估中，汇总的平均精确保真度为0.727，而SABRE-best20为0.440，目标感知SABRE为0.481。我们观察到保真度的提升伴随着更高的双量子比特门计数，且主要集中在5量子比特和8量子比特电路系列中；在固定的树动作图下，所有10量子比特系列均优选SABRE-best20。总体而言，我们的结果表明，校准感知的学习型路由可以提高超越门计数驱动编译的保真度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用实时校准数据进行优化的图强化学习量子电路路由方法。通过将硬件校准信息纳入决策过程，该方法在小规模电路中显著提升了执行保真度，验证了校准感知编译在噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）处理器中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 量子电路路由, 强化学习, 校准感知, 量子计算, 保真度优化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将量子芯片的实时校准数据纳入路由算法，打破了传统仅关注门操作数量（Gate Count）的局限性。其局限性在于该方法在较大规模量子电路（如10量子比特）上的表现不如传统SABRE算法，表明模型泛化能力仍有提升空间。

title: The saturation number is not bounded by the harmonic index
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures. Refutes Conjecture 4 of arXiv:2507.17780. v2 credits the prior refutation by T. Biyikoglu (MATCH Commun. Math. Comput. Chem. 96(3):1097-1099, 2026) and adds tree results: subdivided-star counterexamples and a proof that every nontrivial tree T satisfies mu*(T) < (3/2) H(T), with the constant 3/2 best possible. Verification code at https://github.com/ChakshuGupta13/lab
summary: TxGraffiti conjectured in 2023 that every nontrivial connected graph $G$ satisfies $μ^*(G) \le H(G)$, where $μ^*(G)$ is the saturation number and $H(G)$ is the harmonic index. The conjecture is false. As first shown by B$\imath$y$\imath$koğlu (2026), the ratio $μ^*(G)/H(G)$ can be made arbitrarily large. That refutation is complemented here in three ways. The friendship graph $F_4$ is a counterexample on nine vertices, and an exhaustive enumeration confirms that nine is the smallest order admitting any counterexample. The conjecture fails even on trees, and hence on triangle-free graphs and on bipartite graphs more generally. The subdivided star $S_k$, a central vertex joined to $k$ paths of length two, is a counterexample for every $k \ge 5$, and a further enumeration confirms that eleven is the smallest order of any triangle-free counterexample. On this family the ratio $μ^*(S_k)/H(S_k)$ exceeds $1$ but stays below $3/2$, and in fact every nontrivial tree $T$ satisfies $μ^*(T) < \frac{3}{2} H(T)$ with the constant best possible, in contrast to the unbounded separation possible without the tree restriction. The conjecture does hold for every graph in which all vertices have the same degree, in which case $H(G) = n/2$.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Refutes Conjecture 4 of arXiv:2507.17780. v2 credits the prior refutation by T. Biyikoglu (MATCH Commun. Math. Comput. Chem. 96(3):1097-1099, 2026) and adds tree results: subdivided-star counterexamples and a proof that every nontrivial tree T satisfies mu*(T) < (3/2) H(T), with the constant 3/2 best possible. Verification code at https://github.com/ChakshuGupta13/lab

AI.title_translation: 饱和数不受调和指数限制
AI.tldr: 本文证伪了饱和数小于等于调和指数的猜想，发现该比值在一般图中可无限增大，但在树图中存在3/2的界限。
AI.motivation: 验证并最终驳斥了TxGraffiti提出的关于非平凡连通图饱和数（μ*）小于或等于调和指数（H）的猜想。
AI.method: 通过计算枚举（寻找最小反例）、构造特定图类（如细分星图）以及数学推导（分析树图的界限）来验证猜想的失效。
AI.result: 证明了该猜想是错误的。发现了最小反例为9个顶点的友谊图F4；证明了该猜想在树、无三角形图及二部图中均不成立；给出了树图中饱和数与调和指数的最优界限为3/2。
AI.conclusion: 饱和数并不受调和指数的线性限制。尽管在正则图中猜想成立，但在一般图和树中，饱和数与调和指数的比值可能趋于无穷或存在确定的上界。
AI.translation: TxGraffiti在2023年推测，每个非平凡连通图G都满足μ*(G) ≤ H(G)，其中μ*(G)是饱和数，H(G)是调和指数。该猜想是错误的。正如Bıyıkoğlu (2026)首次展示的那样，比值μ*(G)/H(G)可以变得任意大。本文从三个方面补充了这一反驳。友谊图F4是一个9个顶点的反例，穷举证实了9是允许任何反例的最小阶数。该猜想甚至在树上也不成立，因此在无三角形图和更一般的二部图上也不成立。细分星图Sk（一个中心顶点连接到k条长度为2的路径）对于每个k ≥ 5都是一个反例，进一步的枚举证实了11是任何无三角形反例的最小阶数。在这个族上，比值μ*(Sk)/H(Sk)超过1但保持在3/2以下，事实上每个非平凡树T都满足μ*(T) < 3/2 H(T)，且该常数是最佳的，这与没有树限制时可能出现的无界分离形成了鲜明对比。该猜想对于所有顶点具有相同度数的图确实成立，在这种情况下H(G) = n/2。
AI.summary: 本文旨在探讨饱和数与调和指数之间的关系。研究表明，TxGraffiti关于两者之间存在线性界限的猜想是错误的。文中通过枚举法确定了最小反例，并证明了该猜想在树及更广泛的图类中均不成立，同时给出了树图中两者的精确界限，但指出在正则图中该猜想依然成立。
AI.keywords: 饱和数, 调和指数, 猜想证伪, 友谊图, 树图
AI.comments: 本文通过严谨的数学枚举与构造，成功证伪了关于饱和数与调和指数关系的猜想，并细化了在树结构等特殊图类下的界限，体现了图论中反例寻找与界限分析的重要性。

title: Designing Recommendation Exposure and Favorite Lists: A Field Experiment in a Spot-Work Platform
summary: How should recommender systems be designed when recommendations shape access to scarce, short-lived opportunities? We study this question in a production setting: Timee, Japan's largest platform for spot work, where workers favorite job templates and receive notifications when firms post shifts from those templates. Maximizing predicted favoriting can generate misdirected concentration: recommendations accumulate on popular templates that create few viable job openings, while templates with unmet labor demand receive too little exposure. We design exposure-control mechanisms for favorite-list management, reallocating template exposure based on posting activity and unfilled capacity. The proposed recommender, thresholded eligibility control (TEC), is fully parallelizable and suitable for large-scale digital platforms. In simulations calibrated to Timee data, TEC raises the per-round job-finding rate from 57.6% to 70.0%. A prefecture-level randomized field experiment increases realized matches and exposure per active template, reduces the share of low-exposure templates, and improves impression-level favoriting and downstream matching.

AI.title_translation: 设计推荐曝光与收藏列表：零工平台的一项实地实验
AI.tldr: 针对零工平台推荐算法导致热门职位资源过剩、冷门职位需求无法满足的问题，作者提出了一种基于供需的动态曝光控制机制（TEC），显著提升了平台匹配效率。
AI.motivation: 在零工平台中，传统的最大化预测收藏率的推荐算法会导致资源过度集中在热门但职位空缺少的模板上，而导致真正有大量劳动力需求的模板曝光不足，从而降低了市场的整体匹配效率。
AI.method: 研究者设计了一种名为“阈值资格控制”（Thresholded Eligibility Control, TEC）的机制，根据职位的发布活跃度和未填补的空缺容量，动态调整职位模板的曝光量，并利用模拟和县级随机实地实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在模拟测试中，TEC将每轮求职成功率从57.6%提升至70.0%；在实地实验中，该机制不仅增加了实际匹配数量和模板曝光度，还减少了低曝光模板的比例，并改善了整体的收藏与后续匹配效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过实施阈值资格控制（TEC）机制，平台能够有效地将资源从热门但产出低的模板重新分配到需求未满足的模板，显著提高了零工市场的匹配效率和机会分配公平性。
AI.translation: 当推荐系统决定了对稀缺且短暂的机会的获取时，应该如何设计？我们在日本最大的零工平台Timee进行了研究：工人们收藏工作模板，并在公司发布这些模板的班次时收到通知。最大化预测收藏率可能导致错误的目标集中：推荐信息积聚在那些几乎没有实际职位空缺的流行模板上，而有未满足劳动需求的模板获得的曝光却太少。我们为收藏列表管理设计了曝光控制机制，根据发布活动和未填补的容量重新分配模板曝光。所提出的推荐器“阈值资格控制”（TEC）是完全可并行的，适用于大规模数字平台。在基于Timee数据校准的模拟中，TEC将每轮求职成功率从57.6%提高到70.0%。一项县级随机实地实验增加了实际匹配和每个活跃模板的曝光，减少了低曝光模板的份额，并改善了印象水平的收藏和下游匹配。
AI.summary: 本文研究了零工平台中推荐系统如何平衡机会分配与匹配效率的问题。针对传统算法导致资源过度集中在热门模板的弊端，作者提出了一种阈值资格控制（TEC）机制，通过动态调整曝光以匹配实际职位需求。实验证明，该方法能显著提升零工匹配率并优化资源配置。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统, 零工经济, 资源分配, 匹配效率, 实地实验
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将推荐系统设计与平台供需匹配的实际经济目标（如填补空缺职位）相结合，而非仅仅优化点击率或收藏率。通过在大型零工平台进行的实地实验，验证了算法干预对双边市场效率的显著提升，具有很高的工业界落地价值。

title: A Bayesian Boolean Matrix Factorization with Application to Copy Number Analysis in Cancer
summary: Binary data factorization is common, but real-valued methods ignore discreteness and yield hard-to-interpret factors. Boolean Matrix Factorization (BooMF) instead decomposes a binary matrix into two lower-rank binary matrices via logical AND and OR, expressing the data as a Boolean disjunction of interpretable patterns. In cancer genomics, BooMF can reveal coordinated feature changes that may drive tumor evolution, unlike rotational or additive decompositions. Most existing BooMF methods are heuristic, greedy, sensitive to initialization, prone to local optima, and do not support principled model selection or uncertainty quantification. We introduce Bayesian Boolean Matrix Factorization (BBMF), a fully conjugate generative model with sparsity-inducing priors. It enforces Boolean constraints, yields interpretable latent factors with coherent uncertainty quantification, and admits Gibbs sampling with closed-form full conditionals. Because cancer evolution often involves widespread, near-simultaneous chromosome-number changes (e.g., whole-genome duplication followed by instability and selection), Boolean factorizations capture these patterns more naturally than additive models. Applied to arm-level copy-number alteration data in multiple myeloma, where entries indicate presence/absence of chromosomal-arm amplifications, BBMF finds a small set of interpretable bicliques linking patient subsets to recurrently co-altered chromosomal arms, providing a compact, biologically meaningful summary of tumor heterogeneity and demonstrating BBMF's utility for uncovering discrete latent structure in complex binary data.

AI.title_translation: 一种贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解方法及其在癌症拷贝数分析中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解（BBMF）方法，通过Gibbs采样解决了传统布尔分解的优化难题，并在癌症拷贝数分析中展现了优越的解释力和实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的布尔矩阵分解方法多为启发式算法，对初始化敏感且易陷入局部最优；同时，传统的实值矩阵分解忽略了数据的离散性，且在癌症基因组分析中缺乏解释力。
AI.method: 提出了一种贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解（BBMF）模型，采用全共轭生成模型及稀疏诱导先验，强制执行布尔约束，并利用Gibbs采样及其闭式完全条件分布进行模型推断。
AI.result: BBMF在多发性骨髓瘤的拷贝数变异数据应用中，成功识别出一组小而可解释的“双团”（bicliques），有效地将患者子集与反复共变的染色体臂联系起来，提供了肿瘤异质性的紧凑总结。
AI.conclusion: BBMF为处理二值化数据提供了一个鲁棒、可解释且具有统计严谨性的框架，有效揭示了癌症基因组中的潜在模式和肿瘤异质性。
AI.translation: 二值数据分解在许多领域都很常见，但实值分解方法往往忽略了数据的离散性，导致因子难以解释。布尔矩阵分解（BooMF）通过逻辑“与”和“或”将二值矩阵分解为两个低秩二值矩阵，将数据表示为可解释模式的布尔析取。在癌症基因组学中，与旋转或加性分解不同，BooMF可以揭示驱动肿瘤演化的协同特征变化。现有的BooMF方法大多是启发式、贪婪的，对初始化敏感，容易陷入局部最优，且不支持原则性的模型选择或不确定性量化。我们引入了贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解（BBMF），这是一种具有稀疏诱导先验的完全共轭生成模型。它强制执行布尔约束，产生具有一致不确定性量化的可解释潜在因子，并支持具有闭式完全条件分布的Gibbs采样。由于癌症演化通常涉及广泛且近乎同时发生的染色体数目变化（例如全基因组复制，随后是不稳定性和选择），布尔分解比加性模型更能自然地捕捉这些模式。通过应用于多发性骨髓瘤的臂级拷贝数变异数据（其中条目表示染色体臂扩增的存在/缺失），BBMF发现了一小部分可解释的“双团”，将患者子集与反复共变的染色体臂联系起来，为肿瘤异质性提供了紧凑、生物学上有意义的总结，并证明了BBMF在揭示复杂二值数据中离散潜在结构方面的效用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解（BBMF）模型，旨在解决传统布尔分解方法在优化和不确定性量化方面的缺陷。通过引入稀疏诱导先验和Gibbs采样，BBMF不仅保持了布尔分解的解释性，还为癌症基因组学中的离散拷贝数变异分析提供了更稳健的统计工具。
AI.keywords: 布尔矩阵分解, 贝叶斯推断, 癌症基因组学, 拷贝数变异, 潜在结构分析
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将贝叶斯框架引入布尔矩阵分解（BooMF），解决了传统启发式方法容易陷入局部最优、缺乏不确定性量化以及难以进行模型选择的问题。其核心贡献在于通过共轭先验实现了Gibbs采样，使得模型在计算上更高效且具有可解释性，特别适合处理癌症基因组学中离散的拷贝数变异数据。

title: A Generic Multi-dimensional Symbol Construction for Digital Over-the-Air Computation and Practical Aspects
comments: This work is being submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. GitHub: https://github.com/alphansahin/Over-the-Air-Computation/tree/main/Synchronization%20Testbed
summary: In this paper, we propose a general-purpose multi-dimensional symbol construction for computing an arbitrary symmetric function with digital over-the-air computation (OAC) and discuss the practical aspects of coherent aggregation. For our first contribution, we discuss the categorical representation of a symmetric function. By using this representation and leveraging the sufficiency of the histogram to evaluate a symmetric function, i.e., inspired by type-based multiple access (TBMA), we introduce a general approach to design a single set of OAC symbols to compute any digital function. For our second contribution, we use a comprehensive platform based on low-cost nodes that maintain synchronization in time, frequency, phase, and amplitude via a trigger mechanism, enabling coherent OAC experiments without Global Positioning System (GPS) or cable-based synchronization. Using measurements from the platform, we characterize the phase and amplitude statistics of the composite channel to derive a realistic impairment model for coherent OAC. Through a comprehensive analysis, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme under impairments captured by the proposed model
comment: This work is being submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. GitHub: https://github.com/alphansahin/Over-the-Air-Computation/tree/main/Synchronization%20Testbed

AI.title_translation: 一种用于数字空中计算的通用多维符号构造及其工程实现研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种计算任意对称函数的通用数字空中计算方法，并构建了一个无需GPS或线缆的低成本同步实验平台进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的空中计算（OAC）方法往往针对特定函数设计，缺乏通用性，且在实际硬件实现中面临复杂的同步和信道损伤挑战。
AI.method: 1. 利用对称函数的范畴表示和直方图充分性（受TBMA启发）设计通用OAC符号；2. 构建基于低成本节点和触发机制的实验平台实现时间、频率、相位及幅度同步；3. 通过实测数据表征复合信道统计特性并建立损伤模型。
AI.result: 成功实现了任意对称函数的数字OAC计算，通过提出的实验平台和损伤模型验证了该方案在实际环境中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的通用多维符号构造方法和基于低成本节点的同步机制，有效解决了数字OAC在计算任意对称函数及相干聚合方面的难题，通过实验验证了该方案在实际信道损伤下的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种通用的多维符号构造方法，用于利用数字空中计算（OAC）计算任意对称函数，并讨论了相干聚合的实际应用方面。作为第一项贡献，我们讨论了对称函数的范畴表示。通过使用这种表示并利用直方图在评估对称函数方面的充分性（即受基于类型多址接入/TBMA的启发），我们引入了一种设计单组OAC符号以计算任何数字函数的通用方法。作为第二项贡献，我们使用了一个基于低成本节点的综合平台，通过触发机制保持时间、频率、相位和幅度的同步，从而实现了无需全球定位系统（GPS）或基于电缆同步的相干OAC实验。利用来自该平台的测量数据，我们表征了复合信道的相位和幅度统计特性，从而导出了用于相干OAC的真实损伤模型。通过全面的分析，我们证明了所提方案在所建模型捕获的损伤下的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于数字空中计算的通用多维符号构造方法，以实现任意对称函数的计算。此外，作者开发了一个基于低成本节点的实验平台，通过触发机制实现了高精度的同步，并基于实测数据建立了符合实际的复合信道损伤模型，验证了方案的有效性。
AI.keywords: 数字空中计算, 多维符号构造, 对称函数, 相干聚合, 硬件实验平台
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种通用的多维符号构造方法，能够计算任意对称函数，并结合了基于低成本节点的实际实验平台，填补了理论模型与实际硬件实现之间的差距，对于推进数字空中计算（OAC）的工程落地具有重要意义。

title: Covert Multi-Hop Communications for Heterogeneous Networks With Multiple Wardens
summary: This paper investigates covert multi-hop communications in heterogeneous wireless networks monitored by multiple passive wardens. To maximize network-wide covertness while satisfying a strict end-to-end rate requirement, we jointly optimize routing, modality selection, and transmit power. Under a simultaneous multi-hop transmission scheme, we analyze the detection capabilities of two distinct warden models: colluding wardens employing a central fusion center, and non-colluding wardens operating independently. For both models, we derive optimal detectors and exact expressions for the detection error probability (DEP). In addition, to reduce the complexity of evaluating the DEP, we develop highly accurate closed-form approximations based on gamma moment matching and establish rigorous DEP lower bounds using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. Building on this theoretical foundation, we propose an efficient two-stage optimization algorithm that decouples link-level resource allocation from network-level path selection. By translating the KL divergence bounds into a novel, low-complexity routing metric, which universally simplifies to a linear summation of signal-to-noise ratios, we substantially reduce the computational overhead compared to conventional per-hop detection-based metrics. Finally, numerical simulations validate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the near-optimal performance of the proposed framework.

title: Cell-Free Integrated Sensing and Communication
summary: Cell-free (CF) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) merges the CF architecture with ISAC functionalities. CF-ISAC leverages distributed access points, removes cell boundaries, and enhances coverage, spectral efficiency, and reliability. It also improves energy efficiency, enabling robust multi-user communication, distributed multi-static sensing, and seamless resource optimization. A comprehensive survey on CF-ISAC has been lacking. This monograph addresses that gap by covering the foundational principles, cooperative transmission, radar cross-section, target parameter estimation, ISAC integration levels, sensing metrics, and key applications. It also explores the advantages of multi-static sensing. Performance analysis, resource allocation, security, and user/target-centric designs are discussed. Finally, synchronization, multi-target detection, interference management, and fronthaul limitations are discussed. Advanced antenna technologies, network-assisted systems, near-field CF-ISAC, cross-technology integration, and machine learning approaches are presented.

AI.translation: 无蜂窝（CF）感知通信一体化（ISAC）将 CF 架构与 ISAC 功能相结合。CF-ISAC 利用分布式接入点，消除了蜂窝边界，增强了覆盖范围、频谱效率和可靠性。它还提高了能源效率，实现了稳健的多用户通信、分布式多静态感知和无缝资源优化。目前尚缺乏关于 CF-ISAC 的全面综述。本专著通过涵盖基础原理、协同传输、雷达散射截面、目标参数估计、ISAC 集成级别、感知指标和关键应用来填补这一空白。它还探讨了多静态感知的优势。讨论了性能分析、资源分配、安全性和以用户/目标为中心的设计。最后，讨论了同步、多目标检测、干扰管理和前传限制。提出了先进的天线技术、网络辅助系统、近场 CF-ISAC、跨技术集成和机器学习方法。
AI.summary: 本文是一篇关于无蜂窝感知通信一体化（CF-ISAC）的综合性综述，探讨了如何通过分布式接入点消除蜂窝边界，从而提升通信性能与多静态感知能力，并详细讨论了系统设计、资源分配、关键挑战及未来技术趋势。
